1.title: My Dear Family
1.content:
Throughout my time at the archaeological dig in Holistone, there hasn't been a day that I haven't missed you, our home, and the smiles of each and every one of you. I hope this letter finds you well, my loves. I think of you often, and I hope you all are safe and happy.

Although I'm far away, I've never forgotten our promise or our family. Every night as I reflect on the day's archaeological discoveries in my tent, I can't help but remember the precious times our family shared, the joy and laughter of the children, and your sweet embrace.

Know that I pray for you and look forward to when I can reunite with you all again. Take care of yourself and the children.

Love you forever,
Gordon

4.title: Top Secret
4.content:
<style="highlight">Burn this letter after you read it</style>
The lord has been left with no choice but to pull out this plan because the stubborn Northville villagers refused to grow Gemvine grapes. They will have to agree to our terms once Northville loses its only source of income. It's regrettable that things have come to this point. Failure is not an option!

Step 1: Lazell and his men will disguise themselves as Northville villagers, sneak into the village, and spread lamp oil everywhere. Then, they will find a hiding spot and wait for the mage's signal.
Step 2: The mage will summon a fire elemental to make the fire look like an accident. If the fire isn't intense enough, you need to add more firewood to make it blaze!

Note: Hogan will be hard to fool. Just in case, find a scapegoat for all of this. Be smart and try to adapt if the situation changes.
As dusk approaches, the villagers will be preparing dinner. <style="highlight">That's the time to move!</style>

5.title: Conclusions
5.content:
...This is the main part of the magic circle, which requires 5 sets of blue manastones. They form a magic design that connects with Merlin's specially designed magic stabilizer to ensure the stability of the spell weave. I have streamlined the magic circle. Should I make some more adjustments accordingly?

I've conducted two additional experiments. Although the streamlined structure utilizing two sets of blue manastones proved to be more convenient to use. However, theoretically, the five-set configuration offers a higher magical capacity. More importantly, it's Merlin's own design!

It's decided! I'll use the five-set structure!

6.title: Eleray's Story
6.content:
... Eleray felt the feathers beneath his wings tremble slightly, a manifestation of his intuitive awareness when facing conundrums created by his suspects. As usual, he should have picked up his beloved pipe and taken a hearty puff, but now he could only grab two tavern fries and stuff them into his typically eloquent yellow beak—whose remarkable color matched the fries extraordinarily well.

It was better than nothing. He thought.

Like the case at hand, his small agency, and his supposed identity as a great detective—with the absence of his pipe, everything else appeared to be of little consequence.

8.title: Internal Announcement
8.content:
Dear Fellow Syndicate Members:

Recently, we've observed internal discussions within the chamber regarding changes in senior personnel. Unfortunately, these discussions have given rise to unrealistic speculations and misleading information. Regrettably, some of this misinformation has seeped beyond the Syndicate's confines, creating highly inappropriate repercussions for both the Syndicate's reputation and the information pertaining to senior personnel.

We hereby reiterate that the Unveiler, Illucia, holds a vital managerial role within the Syndicate. Specific details about her schedule, encompassing attendance and meetings, are classified as sensitive information within the Syndicate's boundaries and should not be discussed in any public setting.

We regret to inform you that members involved in the aforementioned procedural violations will be subject to disciplinary measures.

Let this serve as a warning to all members.

—Adamant Syndicate

10.title: To Mother
10.content:
Mother, I've been thinking of you a lot lately. As one approaches the end of life, are they more fragile in ways? I know some larvae wrap themselves in a hard shell but never hatch. In a way, they haven't fully been born yet, enduring silently until the end.

You said that one must learn to admit weakness, and so I remembered every cry and every prayer from earlier days. Now I am praying, Mother, as you taught me to pray.

The people I was with are gone, hunted by spiders or lost to thirst, but I'm alive. I want to keep living.

Mother, how I want to stay in Alkali and be with you... There's so much more I want to do... (some of the text is smudged)

12.title: Faded Journal
12.content:
Today's sea breeze has blown the coconuts all over the ground.
I've lost track of how long I've been here; the markings I made on the stump have become so numerous that they're difficult to make out.
The climate here seems perpetually stuck in late summer. There are no monsoons or ocean currents, rendering all navigation and seasonal techniques useless. Fortunately, the fish jump onto the shore by themselves, and oysters and coconuts are easy to find.
When the weather is nice, I go to the legendary site where the god is said to have bestowed treasure to enjoy the breeze and sun.
So be it… The mysteries I cannot decipher will be left for those who come later.
<align="right"><style="highlight">Roswald</style>

14.content:
For the 90th time, I was halted by a golem.
Perhaps I am not the chosen one of the god of the waves.
Fortunately, most of the golems are only following orders to stand guard, so even after numerous failures to pass them, they haven't attacked me.
For us ordinary mortals who cannot pass the trials, this is the sole mercy from the deity who placed them here.

20.title: July 13th, Clear
20.content:
The mist coils around like a sea serpent; as soon as you step outside, it wraps around your calves.

Cecilia said she heard trumpet sounds in the fog last night and saw black sails that looked like funeral shrouds!
Although I reassured her that what she saw were just fishing nets hung up by the villagers, I knew I needed to prepare myself.

I strapped an iron skillet from the kitchen to my hands, placed a coconut shell on my head, tucked a small knife behind my ear, and wrapped thick coconut leaves around my feet.
I pray the day I fear never arrives.

May Dura continue to protect Greenbrook.

22.title: Old Notebook
22.content:
Month ?? Day ?? 
(The writing is covered in moss)

I saved up some coin and spent it in Rustport on a nice set of repair tools and a handy sword.

Cecilia knocked on my door in the misty rain, saying that the hinges on hers were rusty. Every time she used her door, it'd screech like a rooster.

I told her that it's better than having a real one. You don't need to feed it, and it'll still wake you up every morning.

She laughed and said that if I lived in her house, I probably wouldn't be able to stand it every day.

She's right. That afternoon, after pushing open her door, I replaced the hinges with new ones and also installed a new latch. The old lock was corroded beyond recognition. That's the downside of living by the sea.

"Now, that's a fine lock. Are you trying to keep me locked in forever?" Cecilia joked with a smile. "When are you planning to set out? Haven't you always wanted to go on an adventure and become a hero from those storybooks?"

I didn't dare look into her eyes. Of course, I yearn for the boundless fields and whispering forests she serenades, for the eternal snow that never fades. Her songs paint a world of such breathtaking beauty.

Yet, I'm bound. I understand what chains me, what holds me from wandering away.

I'm held captive... how wonderful it would be to do like Cecilia said.

23.title: Old Notebook
23.content:
It's been three days since we were captured, and still no word on what will happen to us. Had I known these Graveborn pirates wouldn't search us, I wouldn't have torn the diary apart and brought along the whole thing. I didn't want them to find it and realize she's alive. It's better this way. She'll be safe. I trust I can get through this and be with her again.

...

It's the twelfth experiment. Renas from the village didn't make it. I might be next.
She… is still waiting for me. But I can't escape. My nails are broken... it's hard to hold the pen.

Even if just one more time, I long to hear her voice and see her smile. But after another experiment, will I still remember her? Can I still return?

There is only one thing I can do. She can't be captured by these Graveborn! I promised her that I would protect her with my life…
I need to hide away...

24.title: Research Draft 3
24.content:
Research Report - Draft 3
Experiment Number: 2739, Group B-003

In light of previous failures, the <style="highlight">Soul Extraction</style> steps have been revised. Within observable ranges, a soul freed from its material confinement can remain in a non-material state for more than ten days before vanishing.
Rational assessment result: Extremely poor. The subject cannot maintain memory, exhibits no logical behavior, and all attempts to sustain its willpower have failed.

Fusion result: Unpredictable. The material entity receiving the foreign soul exhibits significantly different outcomes:
1) 76% of the material entity exploded into fragments that are no longer valuable for experimentation. A small amount of bone fragments can be kept for the Darkviper's amusement, and the rest should be sent for waste disposal.
2) 21% of the material entity maintains its original form. Testing shows no observable external reactions. Transfer to the observation area for further study.
3) 3% of the material entity (writing is unclear)… attempts to combine more foreign substances… interesting, <style="highlight">she opened her eyes</style>.

<style="highlight">Lead Researcher's</style> Observation:
Records of negative results need to be backed up and transferred; the rest should be destroyed.
We require additional time and materials.

25.title: Message in a Bottle
25.content:
Today is the 320th day since my father and brother went to sea, and they still haven't come back.

Mother says strange things always happens at out on the ocean, and it's normal for ships to come back late, but the fog is so thick right now. The sailors at the docks say you can't see anything in it. Several ships have already crashed into the rocks or had gotten lost and never returned.

No, I can't think like that. I know my father and brother will return. They're the best sailors in all of Rustport. No matter how thick the fog is, they'll find a way. Maybe the fog is just heavier than they thought, so it's taking longer. Yeah, that must be it.

While they're gone, I have to be good and not make Mother sad. She's been sighing a lot lately. I think she's really worried as well. I need to find a way to make her happy again.

Dad told me that when Mother was younger, she loved taking care of all kinds of fish. And when he asked her to marry him, he even caught a rainbow fish out on an island to give to her! I think it was called a rainbow snapper?

If I can find a rainbow snapper and give it to Mom, I'm sure it'll make her smile.

Dad told me stories about the sea. He said that if I'm good, kind, and keep my promises, the sea will make my wishes come true.

Dear sea, <style="highlight">I wish for a beautiful rainbow snapper</style>, not to show off or cause trouble, but to make my mother happy! Please, grant my wish. I promise to always listen to my parents and never make them worry again.

<align="right">From the southern outskirts of Rustport,</align>
<align="right">A really obedient child (I promise), Almer</align>

37.title: Messy Letter
37.content:
Elder Sister:
Due to the ship being unable to set sail, I don't know when this letter will reach you. By the time you receive it, I might have already become an old man. But I want to let you know not to worry about me; I'm doing well here in Rustport.
Even if all isn't perfect, at least I've been lucky to meet a kind soul named Lucca. He is the second-in-command of the Carmine Whispers.
With no hesitation he allowed me to join them, and I finally found a place that feels like home.
Later, I was injured during a fight with the Water Wights, and my right hand became too weak to use—I can now only write with my left hand. Lucca didn't send me away; instead, he found me lighter work so I could stay on with the Carmine Whispers.
Now I'm in charge of guarding the warehouse. Although the job is boring, it's certainly better than the days I spent wandering the streets.
Sister, I understand that I've made mistakes and that I might never return to you, but please don't worry about me. I'm not alone in Rustport; I just frequently think of you and Lily.
Lily's mother left us too soon, and I am not someone deserving of being a father. The child is very intelligent and chose to live with you early on, not be encumbered by me.

52.title: Message in a Bottle
52.content:
Today is the 320th day since Dad and Brother went on their ship, and they still haven't come back.

People say it's easy to get stuck in the fog and that lots of ships get lost and never find their way home... But Dad and Brother are the best at sailing. I just know they found a safe way back! The fog must be super thick, so it's taking them longer to get through. Yeah, that has to be it!

Mom's been sighing a lot lately. I think she's really worried too. I need to find a way to make her happy!
I remember Dad telling me that when he asked Mom to marry him, he gave her a rainbow snapper as a present. He said she loved keeping fish when she was younger, and that rainbow snapper was so colorful and pretty, Mom loved it right away!

If I can find a rainbow snapper and give it to Mom, I'm sure it'll make her smile!

Dad told me stories about the sea. If I'm good, kind, and keep my promises, the sea will make my wishes come true!

Dear sea, <style="highlight">I wish for a beautiful rainbow snapper</style>, not to show off or cause trouble, but to make Mom happy! Please, grant my wish! I promise to always listen to Mom and Dad and never make them worry again!

<align="right">From the southern outskirts of Rustport,</align>
<align="right">A really obedient child (I promise!), Almer</align>

It contains a letter from Rustport, written by a little boy living in the southern suburbs named Almer.

92.title: Farewell Letter
92.content:
Dear friends, 

I may have already gone by the time this letter reaches you. I'm deeply sorry I couldn't thank you in person.
Let me express my heartfelt gratitude to all of you, as well as your friend. Thank you for recognizing the beauty of my painting and restoring it. Most of all, I'm grateful that you were kind enough to return it to me.
It's a shame that I probably won't live to see it in good shape again. Even though you all have been reassuring me, I know I'm on my last legs.

I'm sorry to impose this on you, but I have one last request—<style="highlight">I'd like my family to have this painting</style> as a remembrance of my time in this world. To treat my illness, my father borrowed money from everywhere and is still buried in debt to this day. The painting is the only legacy I can leave for my destitute family... It hasn't been named yet, has it? If you don't mind, I'd like to call it "Unfinished," since it's my unfinished work... I'm so lucky to have met you in the final moments of my life. May the odds be ever in your favor.
<align="right">Yours sincerely,
<align="right">Levski

95.title: Whiteridge Ballad
95.content:
Radinov's Oath
The Radinovs were once the oldest family in Whiteridge
When Valram Radinov, the first family head, was granted the title of Earl, he swallowed ice in the heavy snow and swore to be the guardian of Whiteridge.
The Radinovs are devout believers of the Divine Light. Some family members even gave up their inheritance to serve Dura at the Whiteridge Temple.
When the First Divine War broke out, Viktor Radinov, the family head at the time, joined forces with the Valesa family to defend Whiteridge against the Hypogeans.
In the early stages of the war, the knight army led by the Radinovs significantly slowed the advance of the Hypofiends, instilling courage and confidence in the people of Whiteridge.
However, it also made the Radinovs the target of the Hypogean's vengeance.
The Hypogeans relentlessly hunted down every member of the Radinov family, nearly wiping them out. Nevertheless, none of them ever gave in.
They all stayed true to their family oath.

100.title: Adventurer's Notes
100.content:
This is my fourth day hiding here. I believe there's still a chance to escape.
As an adventurer, hardly anything rattles me anymore, but I have to admit, this land still surprises me.
Initially, I thought they were just some special creatures like gruglins. I even mocked the locals for fearing them and calling them the "undead."
But now, I'm beginning to see myself as the protagonist of a local cautionary tale.
"There was once a stubborn adventurer who insisted on venturing into the ancient battlefield. What happened next? Well, he was eaten by the undead of course..."
Ah, I must stay calm. I've still got plenty of food. Dura above, please keep the undead away from me.

101.title: Something feels off!
101.content:
For some reason, the acolytes at the temple started disappearing.
Thinking the undead were behind it, I suggested to the caretaker that we increase the night patrols. Yet, it didn't make a difference...
In the meantime, I noticed something was off with the atmosphere in the temple.
I often saw Brother Lartz and the others gathering in the woods by the temple. Whenever I tried getting closer, they would quickly scatter.
...
Dura above! What audacity?!
They secretly built an altar! It gave off such a powerful, evil aura that merely seeing it from afar sent chills through my soul!
I must inform the caretaker about this. Such a blasphemous act must be stopped!
...
...
...
I've opened my arms to him... and it feels incredible!

107.title: The Mage and the Adventurer
107.content:
Once upon a time, there was a little adventurer who aspired to explore the entirety of Esperia on foot. However, fear held her back, as she was intimidated by the howling winds and biting cold.
Meanwhile, there was a great mage well-versed in all the spells of the world. He had a great sense of humor and a charming personality. On a dark, starless night, the great mage knocked on the little adventurer's door.
"I'll keep you safe," the mage promised. "I'll use magic to dispel all evil and clear every obstacle so you can have a joyful and safe journey."
"Really? That's very kind of you, sir! But I'm so small that I can't even reach your shoulders. What can I do to repay your kindness?" the little adventurer asked sheepishly.
"The scenery we share along the way will be enough!" the mage replied with a hearty laugh.
Just like that, the great mage and the little adventurer embarked on a journey together. They would travel to many places and admire the beauty of Esperia.
All they needed to do for an epic adventure was to take that very first step.
<style="highlight">To my dear little Carly—you are the purest snowflake in the world.</style>

108.title: Decayed Journal
108.content:
(The binding of this notebook is worn, and a few delicate pages are scattered inside the stone coffin. The handwriting is barely discernible in the light filtering in through the window.)
 "Bravo, Radinov! Well done! You could become an honorary dwarf!" Callan's face turned crimson immediately! Hahaha! His reaction reminded me of my first child, born fifty years ago.
 We crouched down again and tinkered with the mechanical parts for a while. "We should cast it with brass." "No, we should use steel... steel with 3% carbon..."
 As I took the mug of brew that he handed me, I asked, "Is your family okay with you mingling with craftsmen like us?"
 "I think so." He shrugged, trying to change the subject. I knew his family, those high-and-mighty nobles, didn't approve of what he was doing. Yet, what could be more fulfilling than the process of creating something? He knew that well.
 I asked Callan what motivated him to create these mechanical golems. After all, there were better designs if he just wanted some regular mechanical servants or soldiers.
 He told me <style="highlight">the appearance of the golems was inspired by the storybooks he and his sister used to read when they were little</style>. He wanted to make sure his sister and other children wouldn't find the mechanical golems frightening.
 Ha! He was so young and naive! His ideals wouldn't hold up in the real world! I'd enlighten him one day, but now, I just want to enjoy this brew for a bit...

109.title: Decayed Letter
109.content:
(The parchment is too tattered for you to make out the words on it. After piecing it together carefully, you recognize some key phrases.)
 Today, I'll answer your doubts about why I invested so much capital and money into developing these machine servants—or as you call them, mechanical golems.
 Even though the creator has passed away, the mechanical golems can still execute commands as long as they have sufficient fuel. They are more loyal and reliable than any living beings you have ever encountered.
 I believe all of you have read the battle reports from the border region. As mere mortals, we are fragile and full of limitations. After we are gone, who will protect our beloved family and friends?
 I'm not a competent mage. I've never have been. Maybe I don't look like a typical member of the Radinov family, but I'm trying to help and protect the people of the duchy in my own way.
 Little Carly is at the temple praying devoutly for the warriors guarding our borderlands. She is contributing to the war in her own way. I must do so as well.
 When she was a child, I invented a tale for her. A master mage created the world's most powerful golem for a frightened little adventurer, making her brave in the end. She smiled at me after hearing that story.
 This might not be the most ideal method, but it's the most efficient path I can take.
 I'll die eventually, but my creation will remain, forever protecting those I cherish.

110.title: Production Guide
110.content:
<style="highlight">How to Process Dragon Eggs</style>
1. Use a large cutter to split the shell. Be careful of any cracks or uneven pieces that may fall.
2. Remove the liquid and guide it to the storage equipment using a drainage tool.
3. Move the shell pieces to the precision cutting area via the conveyor belt.
 
<style="highlight">Machine Manual</style>
1. Cutter: Press the red button to stop, and press the green button to start.
2. Conveyor Belt: When the blue light starts flashing, press the green button to start.
 
<style="highlight">Note:</style>
1. If the yellow light on the storage equipment is flashing, it indicates that the equipment is full. Always keep an eye on it.
2. Only use the drainage tool, pipeline, and conveyor belt when the blue light starts flashing. Make sure to turn them off promptly after use.
3. After the processing is complete, use the cutter and conveyor belt to move all solid waste to the <style="highlight">crusher</style> at the top for disposal.

If you notice fire turning a color other than red, do not leave the cabin.
Second — "One must never venture into the wild after dark."
After the sun goes down, don't go outside! Don't go outside! Don't go outside!

119.title: Collection Description
119.content:
Title of the painting: "Unfinished"
Artist: Levski from Cedartown, died at the age of 25
Description of the painting:
Levski began this piece when he was experiencing a peak in his creative inspiration.
Unfortunately, before the painting was completed, he fell seriously ill. Despite many medical treatments, he was unable to recover and eventually died young.
Before his death, Levski named it "Unfinished" to commemorate his ill-fated and regretful life.
When the wooden frame decays and bugs have devoured the canvas, the painting will once again be with Levski.
May eternal peace and rest find him.

134.title: Amy's Journal
134.content:
Today marks the 100th day of my hospitalization. It's snowing so much outside, and it looks so pretty!

<style="highlight">I really, really want to go out and play!</style> I'm the best at snowball fights, and the snowmen I built always get lots of compliments... I really want to build one for Mommy and Daddy.

Oh, and I also want to make snow angels! Dr. Lev told me how to do it. You just lie down in the snow, spread your arms and legs, and wiggle them around. It sounds so fun!

But they just won't let me go outside! I don't get it, why can't I go? I'm not coughing anymore, and I feel totally fine! Why do I have to stay in here?

I really, really, really want to go out, but I don't want Mommy and Daddy to be sad or worried about me...

...When will I be able to go outside?

I might not be strong enough to walk yet, but don't you think my coughing has gotten a lot better? I believe I'll get well in no time!

I'll take my medicine today, and I'll be better tomorrow. Let me sing you a song then!

138.title: Letter
138.content:
Dear Dura,

Thanks to your blessing, my condition has improved a lot lately, and I can finally get out of bed and walk. However, Daddy is still worried about me, and the doctor insists I must wait until spring before I can head outside.

It's so boring in the ward... Although Daddy and the <style="highlight">maid</style> are with me, I have to keep holding back my cough when they are around to avoid their nagging...

Dura above, could you make spring come sooner? My <style="highlight">maid</style> said that <style="highlight">I'll recover completely when spring arrives</style>, and that means I can finally go out and play! She's praying beside me now. I'm sure you can hear us, right?

<align="right">Your devout believer, Amy

141.title: Yolena's Will
141.content:
Dear Father,

I guess I won't be around when you read this letter. First of all, I'm sorry that I couldn't hold on longer and left before you... Please don't grieve for me, as I've merely gone to a place without pain and bitter medicine. Does it feel a little better seeing it this way?

Father, deep down inside, there's something I've always wanted to do. I still remember the stories you used to tell me when I was little, and my favorites were the ones about the sea. The vast, magnificent ocean in those tales was so different from the frozen lakes we have in Whiteridge. The stories sparked a wish in me: I want to ride a boat along the river, all the way to where it meets the sea for a glimpse of the boundless waters!

You've always warned me about the dangers of the sea, so I'll be content with just a view from the shore, admiring the horizon. The guards once described the sea at sunset to me: the waters change from blue to gold, as if bathed in the Divine Light of Dura... Oh, how I wish I could see it with my own eyes! Why did I have to fall sick...

Attending the Snowspire Festival is likely a pipe dream for me... So, please, promise me you'll hold a water burial for me when I pass, so my spirit can drift toward the sea. The world's simply too fascinating, Father! There are so many joys I can never experience them all. Please don't worry or feel sorrowful, and I forbid you from coming to me! You must live on for many more years, just like the snow on the mountain that never melts, and my unbridled love for you!

I wish to become a petal, so I can kiss you again when the spring breeze carries me over. This year, next year, every year. Over and over again.

Goodbye, Father! I'll always love you.

<align="right">Your most beloved,
<align="right">Yolena

151.title: Hogan's Letter
151.content:
Dear Magister,
Thanks to you and your familiars, my health has mostly recovered, and I've begun my rehabilitation exercises.

How are things on your side? I just wanted to let you know that I've gone through the report. I know the great Merlin won't be stumped by such minor setbacks, but please bear with me—having lived through the entire ordeal myself, I can't help but feel uneasy at how deliberately understated the report was.

From my investigation, it appears that the royal court has swept the rebellion in Brimstone Village under the rug, and the existence of Sal'thorin and the Essail remains a secret to the public. Apparently, this is the calm before the storm, as the royal court is still assessing the crisis. Once they have the full picture, the storm may well break.

For the royal court, what matters most is the <style="highlight">loyalty</style> of its territories. If that's missing, they should at least offer some <style="highlight">benefit</style> to the empire.

By this measure, I'd say Brimstone Village is now in an extremely precarious position. They can no longer craft their echorite weapons, and the empire has secured other suppliers for underground resources. In other words, with no value and no trust, Brimstone Village holds no meaning for the Lightbearer Empire.

While the empire likely won't punish the innocent villagers, its usual methods suggest they'll scatter the remaining population across distant dwarven settlements—or place them under house arrest. As for Brimstone Village itself, it will most likely be abandoned.

Speaking from an unbiased perspective, I believe it would be a huge waste to simply erase such a historically rich village with outstanding craftsmanship, even though we only got a brief glimpse of it during our visit.

The empire will soon send <style="highlight">an envoy</style> to the village for an inspection.

The arrival of the envoy will be a crisis in itself, but with timely interventions, it could become an opportunity for the village to reverse its fortunes.

I can only bring you up to speed on the current situation in this letter, my old friend. I'm afraid I can't offer you any suggestions or advice at this moment.

I sincerely hope that the famous echorite weapons will be preserved.

All the best!

<align="right">Take care.
<align="right">Yours faithfully,
<align="right">Hogan

153.title: Revival Agenda
153.content:
Rise, my peers!
Spending your whole life as nothing more than a blacksmith for humans—is that truly what you want?
Playing to the whims and fancies of those high-and-mighty, ugly faces—do you actually enjoy that?
Are you really content with the peanuts humans give you in exchange for your echorites, living a life without dignity?

Not for us!

We've been brainwashed by humans for far too long, forgetting the success and glory we once had!
We thrive in the mines and around the lava! It's time to forge our own future with hammers and anvils!

Forget about the echorites! Forget about the Lightbearer Empire! Let's rebuild the Ironheart Dominion!

<align="right">From Inna, your most trustworthy leader, companion, and best friend.

155.title: Brew Recipe
155.content:
Steps to prepare the dwarven brew:
1. Plant wheat in moist, clean soil to allow it to germinate quickly.
2. For the best results, use mountain spring water.
3. After harvesting the malt, don't wash off the soil! The soil helps speed up the fermentation process.
4. Make sure the barrel is tightly sealed during fermentation! Otherwise, a mysterious gas will contaminate the brew and turn it sour.
5. If you prefer your drink free of soil, remember to place a cloth over the barrel's opening as a filter before pouring.

Things are not exactly great here lately.
The Essail have thrown the underground into utter disarray.
To survive, I have to go.
Only Helthor knows when I will be back.
If you come across this recipe, feel free to enjoy the brew I left behind—just don't waste it.
If I haven't returned by the time the brew runs out, you can make it yourself following the recipe.

160.title: Nourishing Soup

Add the spiritroots to the pot and let it stew on high heat. Their faint fragrance balances out the sweetness of the radishes. Once their combined flavors are fully released, you'll have a delicious, nourishing soup.

Something perfect for warming both your hands and your body on a chilly day!

170.title: Conversation Log
170.content:
Today, I talked to Tasso about promoting dragon egg essence usage. This is a brief record of our conversation for future reference.

Me: The positive effects of dragon egg essence on corruption have been proven. There are minimal side effects.
Tasso: I'm afraid I have to veto this. Dragon eggs are the offspring of a magnificent being. Using or consuming them could lead to negative consequences.
Me: Is that your only concern?
Tasso: (He spoke after about a minute of silence) Yes, at least for the time being.
Me: Most of us won't live long enough to experience the side effects, and some might not even survive until we complete the tests. (I've forgotten the exact wording, but the gist is the same.)
Tasso: I understand where you're coming from, but what about Sylvan Tendril?
Me: I said <style="highlight">"most of us."</style>
Tasso: (He didn't speak for a long time here, and I remember urging him at least three times.) How do you plan to distribute it?
Me: What do you think? Should I prioritize the critically ill, or should those who are more capable or loyal get it first?
Tasso: I believe you already have a decision in mind, and I'm fairly certain I know what it is.
Me: I suppose you'll veto that decision as well, right?
Tasso: You're spot on.

178.title: Feli's Log (10)
178.content:
The experiment is almost complete, but it's not perfect yet...
Be that as it may, I haven't come up with any new ideas lately. Guess I just have to put the experiment on hold for now.
Lately, I keep having dreams about my forest being discovered by others... Instead of fearing it...
Why not prepare for it in advance and leave some rewards for whoever finds it?
Hmm, what kind of rewards should I prepare? And how do I give them hints?

All set! Here's my plan for now: the flying squirrel will be the guide, while the hopping mushroom sprites will show the correct directions...
It's both mysterious and fun!
Firstly, I need to come up with a chant that summons the hopping mushroom sprites...
<style="highlight">"Mushroom sprite! Hopping is alright!"</style> This sounds good!
My design's so cool! This way, if I ever forget the location, I'll be able to find the forest again!
I'm the youngest high priest in Sal'thorin, after all!

179.title: Tor's Journal
179.content:
Day 47
I noticed something strange while checking the storage today. Those "ores" seem to have a faint pulse... Could they actually be alive?

Day 53
I examined the inside of the "ores" and found something that resembled an embryo. I couldn't sleep a wink that night.

Day 61
At last, I figured it out—the ores are actually eggs, with something alive growing inside. But seriously, what kind of creature lays eggs that huge?

Day 68
I came across some torn pages of ancient tome and saw the illustrations inside... These "ores" are actually dragon eggs! Oh Helthor, what have we done?! They are dragons—the noble beings who were once our allies!

Day 75
The crusher has been built. They want us to process these eggs, grinding them into echorites and draining the liquid inside for those Pointy Ears.

The Final Day
I can't go on any longer. Every night, I hear their cries—they won't even have a chance to see the light of day...
The burden of the truth is too heavy. I must leave Brimstone Village, a place consumed by sin.
May Helthor forgive my cowardice and absolve all of our sins.

184.title: Stele Inscription
184.content:
The gods have blessed our kind!
Our hammers strike, without respite!
Our furnace burns, a constant glow!

In honor of Helthor, we held a ceremony here.
We offered our treasured items, our hearts sincere.

Burning liquid flows with fiery grace, forging crystals in their place. Magic washes away the dirt, the secret of craftsmanship is overt!

Our heirs of tomorrow, guard this legacy well. The dwarven art shall in ages dwell. Though monuments crumble and fade, the artistry of dwarves shall never degrade!

...hell... My homeland... no chance to return...
...why... can't I... let go...

189.title: Mystic Dew
189.content:
Gently heat the <style="highlight">coconut oil</style> using a double boiler method.
Add the <style="highlight">honey amber</style> and stir continuously until it is fully dissolved.
Then, remove the petals and leaves from the budding <style="highlight">etching irises</style>. Briefly steep the remaining roots and stems in the warm mixture, then strain them out to infuse their distinct fragrance into the oil.

A solemn word: This recipe was created to aid fellow servants suffering mistreatment at the hands of their masters. Do not, under any circumstances, divulge it to nobles or any individual who would exploit its secrets for personal gain!

190.content:
Will & Future Plan
Draconization has been significantly alleviated. After ruling out all other physical methods, such as incision and cutting, childbirth now remains the final hurdle.
Currently, the fetus has reached its maximum capacity, and the estimated delivery date is in two weeks.

Note: Inform Velara to be prepared.
Given the risks associated with both magic and childbirth, it is essential to establish a plan for the future.

- In the event of my death, Thador is to issue the order and work with ??? to eliminate Velara. It must be ensured that upon Velara's death, the throne passes to ???. Thador shall fully cooperate.
- If Velara survives, or if ??? refuses to help, Thador is to initiate immediate suppression of all information, and select a new successor to the throne.
- If Thador fails and Velara survives... such a possibility must be eliminated. A contingency must be left for Velara before the child is born.

The finalized version of this document will be drafted once Velara enters her recovery period.

197.title: Letter (Draft)
197.content:
Elsa, after you rejected my confession yesterday, I went home and started writing this letter...

Actually, the ring I wanted to give you is one of a pair. My family gave them to me when I inherited the title of Viscount, and they're said to carry an ancient magic and blessing...

While one of the rings is mine, the other is meant for the person I love. In my heart, it can only have one rightful owner, and that person is you.

I know you love me just as much as I love you. Don't ask how I can tell... Your reddened eyes have already given you away...

But you refused to accept the ring and turned me down...

I understand your concerns, but honestly, our social statuses don't matter to me. So what if you are a lowborn? With love, we can overcome anything, and we don't need to care about what others think...

Please give me another chance. Let's face the challenges together, alright?

Elsa said yes! She's agreed to be my lover! On that beautiful waterside bridge, she put on the ring and confessed her love to me!

Could it be the Queen's blessing? Or did that breeze give her the courage to face her feelings?
Either way, we're the happiest people in Sal'thorin right now!

The commoners' district is a dreadful place... The people there beat me up and took my Divine Dew because I reminded them of the countless nobles who took theirs...

It's where Elsa was born—destitute and vicious, with people constantly seizing from one another. After living as a plunderer myself for so long, I've received my retribution at last...

I was a foolish idealist... I didn't know a thing about the real world...

But... Elsa! What about her? Now I finally understand why you turned me down at first... If I could do this all over again, I wouldn't confess my feelings to you...

...Deep in the camp... everything ends here...

210.title: I Confess...
210.content:
Your Majesty,

Your humble servant comes before you to repent... um, for the sins I've committed. This morning, during my prayers, I couldn't stifle a yawn. Please, believe me, it's not out of disrespect! It's just that I indulged in a few snacks last night, and the sweetness lingered in my mouth, making my sleep far too deep...

Also, please forgive me for accidentally stepping on a flower in your divine garden. To make amends, I gently propped it up with some soil and whispered a blessing to it. I do hope it won't tell the gardener...

At dinner, I didn't own up when Priestess Leena asked who took the fruit from the altar... Actually, I picked it up on the ground, wiped off the dust, and ate it! I couldn't let it go to waste, right? And honestly, it was quite delicious...

211.title: Simple Note
211.content:
Mages, thank you. You saved more than my life; you saved me from a lifetime of believing a lie.

I trust that you work for peace. I have to believe you had nothing to do with the tragedy in Halia... I choose to believe that.

But my post awaits. The war has begun, and it has changed. With gods descending, this is no longer our fight. It is a tide of divine wrath, and no mortal army can hold it back.

My people may be beyond saving, but you are not. So please, for your own sake, <style="highlight">stand down</style>. Do not throw your lives away for a lost cause. Consider this the last wish of a friend who regrets the path his home has chosen.

Take care of yourselves. Until we meet again.

I trust that you work for peace. I have to believe you had nothing to do with the tragedy in Halia... I choose to believe that.

But my post awaits. The war has begun, and it has changed. With gods descending, this is no longer our fight. It is a tide of divine wrath, and no mortal army can hold it back.

My people may be beyond saving, but you are not. So please, for your own sake, <style="highlight">stand down</style>. Do not throw your lives away for a lost cause. Consider this the last wish of a friend who regrets the path his home has chosen.

Take care of yourselves. Until we meet again.

218.title: FINAL Draft
218.content:
Most Honorable Lord Ravion,

Although the palace is always bustling, I'm used to keeping to myself, fulfilling my role as a maid. However, every time you pass by, the noise around me fades, and my gaze is inevitably drawn to your presence.

I wasn't in a place to write this letter, yet I did, driven by the desire to let my feelings leave a trace—even if only as ink on paper. Whether it's burned to ash or forgotten, it doesn't matter. 227.title: Observations
227.content:
At the foot of the colossal mountain guarded by Misarte lies a small human town called Sita.

Sita is backed by mountains, surrounded by water on three sides. Rugged terrain makes it unfit for normal settlements, but the people here built hollow-wood platforms for their homes.

Most platforms rise two or three men high. During Mistcloud month, the rainy season, the water rises about half a man's height. People here call it a miracle of the gods of earth and river.

In my view, Misarte only wishes to keep the mountain in peace. She dwells far from the other gods, longing for tranquility in all her deeds.

If all gods were like this, the world would know no disasters... Life would be free of suffering. What a beautiful thought.

<align="right">Merlin
<align="right">Mistvine Month, in Sita

228.title: Manuscript
228.content:
The efficacy of the dragon egg essence is undeniable. Within four hours of application, both Tasso and the Captain reported marked alleviation of pain, accompanied by visible wound regeneration.

I had anticipated superior results in the Captain, given her comparative youth. Yet, contrary to expectations, Tasso's convalescence proved more rapid.

This suggests the essence favors robust constitutions—but what principle governs this selectivity?

(Some smudged writing)

Even now, as I write these words, I still feel the urge to mention Misarte. A regrettable reflex, nothing more.

The Captain has moved on with characteristic pragmatism. Tasso, ever the sentimentalist, lingers in the past. He will adapt—or be left behind.

(The handwriting becomes messier from here on)

I cannot believe there are still people who miss Misarte and the place where we were once cast out like stray dogs.

We too are children of the Dark Forest, and we once loved Misarte.

We only sought to protect our homeland, and yet, we were struck with such a cruel, or more accurately, malicious curse.

If this is a goddess' justice, then let history judge which of us is the true monster.

231.title: To Keira...
231.content:

Will no miracle come? You fought for Halia... you were <style="highlight">blessed by the God of Harvest</style>!

Will He <style="highlight">save you again</style>? Like when you were lost in Dregwood, starving, and a <style="highlight">petal umbrella</style> appeared before you?

You told me you saw me and your mother in a dream, and when you woke, we were there.

Others call it a hallucination from the petal umbrella, but we know the truth. It was a miracle. The God of Harvest guided us to you!

And that <style="highlight">wild sandbeast led me there</style>, it was so strong... It surely was <style="highlight">the God's chosen beast</style>!

Keira, I believe you've returned to his embrace. I won't try to take you from His hands. I only pray for one thing...

239.title: Summoner's Stew
239.content:
Summoner's Stew Recipe

<style="highlight">Warning!</style>
Summoning a chaotic monster is risky business! When this dish is done, it will twist space and time!
This recipe is verified by ancient mages and chefs and recorded in ▇▇▇▇

<style="highlight">Ingredient 1: Ancient Bones</style>
You'll need bones from a creature that's lived a thousand years or more. The best ones come from desert monsters, as their bones have been soaking up the earth's essence for centuries. You must cut them under moonlight using silver tools.
A note on sourcing: We do not recommend using your great-great-grandfather's remains, no matter how "ancient" they seem.
 
<style="highlight">Ingredient 2: Deepsea Liver</style>
Picking the right organ is the tricky part. You want one from those ancient races that live in the deepest, darkest parts of the ocean.
After collecting it, keep it submerged in water from its native environment. Do not let it get exposed to the air.

<style="highlight">Ingredient 3: Psychic Monster Meat</style>
The psychic monster meat is both the trickiest yet the most essential ingredient, as these creatures can manipulate minds or create illusions.
It is recommended to wear a tinfoil hat during this step.
 
<style="highlight">Ingredient 4: Rich Element Essence</style>
Element essence serves as a medium to combine other ingredients. Any essence will do, as long as it is pure.

<style="highlight">Cooking Steps</style>
Prepare a large cauldron. Add the ingredients in sequence while stirring continuously.
First stir three times clockwise, then twice counterclockwise. Repeat this process until the contents of the cauldron shimmer with a prismatic shade of black.
If it turns polka-dotted, you've stirred too vigorously.

If you run into any scammers, please report them to the guards. Let's keep fishing honest!

270.title: Work Relaxant
270.content:
Recipe:

Revising our work is inevitable when writing papers, submitting proposals, or drafting reports. In mild cases, it can lead to headaches, but in more extreme situations, it can cause a nervous breakdown.

For patients only experiencing a <style="highlight">headache</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Strain Reliever</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">bitterberries</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">frostcrystals</style>.
This potion helps them calm down while also revitalizing their energy.

For patients already in a state of <style="highlight">agitation</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Calming Potion</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">bitterberries</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">frostcrystals</style>.
This potion clears the mind and brings about a sense of tranquility.

The above herbs must be simmered over <style="highlight">low heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.

Are you a student working on a paper? A designer revising your work? This potion is for you!

271.title: Efficiency Extract
271.content:
Recipe:

Do you find yourself getting easily distracted whenever it's time to work? Do you always procrastinate until the deadline is right around the corner? Believe me, even the famous Lord Ravion struggles with this issue!

For patients <style="highlight">struggling to focus</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Alertness Tonic</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">frostcrystals</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">jumping beans</style>.
This potion keeps creativity flowing, sharpens concentration, and boosts productivity!

For completely <style="highlight">inactive</style> patients,
they need the <style="highlight">Energy Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">frostcrystals</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">jumping beans</style>.
This potion helps the patients overcome procrastination and get them into immediate action!

The above herbs must be boiled over <style="highlight">high heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
If you find it hard to focus on the work you love, give the above potion a try!

272.title: Humility Tonic
272.content:
Recipe:

Following the rise of the heroes, many have experienced unprecedented changes in their status and identity, and some get so caught up in their newfound glory that they can't quite snap out of it. At times like these, a little potion is just what they need to bring them back to reality!

For patients suffering from mild shoulder and neck pain from <style="highlight">holding their heads high for extended periods</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Soul Relaxant</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">bitterberries</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rock mushrooms</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>.
This potion encourages self-reflection, rekindles their dreams, and helps improve shoulder and neck mobility.

For overly arrogant patients <style="highlight">stiff from neck to arms and back</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Fervor Potion</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">bitterberries</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rock mushrooms</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>.
This potion helps reignite their motivation and move them forward toward their dreams.

The above herbs must be boiled over <style="highlight">high heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
If you or your friends and family are suffering from these symptoms, it's best to take this potion without delay! Remember—glory fades the moment it is attained, and humility is what carries us forward!

273.title: Confidence Tonic
273.content:
Recipe:

After the Queen was overthrown, the heroes of Sal'thorin seized control of the city. Many who once held positions of power have faced dramatic shifts in their social standing. For some, the anxiety brought on by these changes has begun to take a toll on both their daily lives and work.

For patients who can't help but <style="highlight">hunch their backs out of self-doubt and fear</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Esteem Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">jumping beans</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">pride antlers</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>.
This potion helps restore confidence!

For patients suffering from <style="highlight">severe lower back and leg pain brought on by prolonged fear</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Courage Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">jumping beans</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">pride antlers</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> o <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>.
This potion empowers patients to pursue their dreams without pain and fear.

The above herbs must be simmered over <style="highlight">low heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
If you or your loved ones are battling these symptoms, cast aside your fear and take this potion! It's never too late to chase your dreams!

274.title: Sincerity Potion
274.content:
Recipe:

Love has always been complicated. Even now, many still struggle with the challenges of relationships in Sal'thorin.

For patients whose <style="highlight">desperate longing for love leads to delusional thoughts</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Disillusion Draught</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rock mushrooms</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">phoenix feathers</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion helps ground patients in reality while reigniting their courage to pursue love.

For patients <style="highlight">consumed by romance</style> to the point that their daily lives are disrupted,
they need the <style="highlight">Clarity Tincture</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rock mushrooms</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">phoenix feathers</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion reminds patients to savor the sweetness of love without losing touch with reality.

The above herbs must be boiled over <style="highlight">high heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
While you immerse yourself in the sweetness of love, don't forget to stay grounded in life and remain true to yourself. Only then will love become even more beautiful.

275.title: Comfort Potion
275.content:
Recipe:

As drastic changes reshape the world, social bonds are shifting too. Lately, it is common to see old friends drifting apart, breaking up, or becoming estranged. Some even suffer illness from the emotional pain.

For patients <style="highlight">having trouble communicating after losing touch with friends</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Mending Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion helps patients pull themselves together and open their hearts to friends again.

For <style="highlight">heartbroken</style> patients whose lives are disrupted by the pain of breakups,
they need the <style="highlight">Heartmend Serum</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion mends their broken hearts so they can beat strongly again.

The above herbs must be simmered over <style="highlight">low heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
Ending a deeply cherished friendship is undeniably painful. However, if you linger too long in the pain, you are the one who suffers most. Whether you aim to salvage the friendship or move on, the first and most crucial step is to let go of the past and take a step forward.

they need the <style="highlight">Heartmend Serum</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion mends their broken hearts so they can beat strongly again.

277.title: Dream Potion
277.content:
Recipe:

Just as some dream of exploring the surface, others long for nothing but a quiet life at home. However, it's important to stay mindful if such desires begin to disrupt daily life.

For patients who simply <style="highlight">dislike going out</style>—so much so that even seeking treatment requires great effort,
they need the <style="highlight">Wanderlust Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">etching irises</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">flamefern</style>.
This potion lifts their spirits and helps them rediscover the joy of going outside.

For patients experiencing <style="highlight">overwhelming panic about the outside world</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Opendoor Philter</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">etching irises</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">flamefern</style>.
This potion helps ease their anxiety completely, replacing it with feelings of happiness and curiosity.

The above herbs must be boiled over <style="highlight">high heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
The choice between adventure and a peaceful life at home is yours to make. However, if excessive anxiety or fear starts to interfere with your daily life, a potion might be just the remedy you need!

278.title: Use it for everything!
278.content:
Recipe:

To prepare an effective potion, one must not only understand the illness itself but also be well-versed in the properties of the herbs. Only by administering the right dosage and precisely controlling the heat can the potion truly cure the disease.

But the process takes time—and as the great Magister, you have far too much on your plate. Sometimes, <style="highlight">randomly</style> tossing in a few herbs and letting the fire <style="highlight">work its magic</style> can lead to something truly special!
Well, if it really exists, might as well call it <style="highlight">Average Aid</style>!

Who knows? A potion like that might just work on all kinds of symptoms! Sure, it may not be perfect every time—but what's so bad about being <style="highlight">average</style>? On the flip side, it might even turn out to be the legendary <style="highlight">Universal Panacea</style> that cures every illness!
If creativity is your thing, just relax and follow your heart!

285.title: Sweet Ale Recipe

3. Add remaining wheat, ferment for 7 days.
4. Bottle with honey, ferment for another 14 days.
Features: Cloudy, sweet, beginner-friendly

292.title: Golden Fields
292.content:
Long ago, Tuttleton suffered from famine.
Moved by their unwavering devotion, the God of Harvest scattered golden wheat here.
In an instant, fields rippled with grain, fruit trees bowed under their weight, and streams ran with honey.
From that day forth, Tuttleton's wheat shone like sunlight, earning it the name Golden Fields.
Each harvest, the townsfolk scatter grain, sing praises to the god, and pray that abundance may never fade.

300.title: Classroom Musings
300.content:
During today's Magic Elements class, some students boldly—and maybe even recklessly—questioned the existence of several well-established elements.

I'm glad to see them thinking critically, but it's crucial that they do so on a solid foundation. After all, nothing good can come from baseless conjecture.

My old professor once said, "Seeds grow into trees, and those trees will, in turn, shelter the saplings in the forest."

Maybe one day, my students will pass this saying on to their own students.

After all, knowledge is the nourishment that keeps the forest of magic alive.

If you or your friends and family are suffering from these symptoms, it's best to take this potion without delay! Remember—glory fades the moment it is attained, and humility is what carries us forward!

311.title: Comfort Potion (I)
311.content:
Recipe:

As drastic changes reshape the world, social bonds are shifting too. Lately, it is common to see old friends drifting apart, breaking up, or becoming estranged. Some even suffer illness from the emotional pain.

For patients <style="highlight">having trouble communicating after losing touch with friends</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Mending Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">hexaflowers</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">glowfly fruits</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>.
This potion helps patients pull themselves together and open their hearts to friends again.

The above herbs must be simmered over <style="highlight">low heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
Ending a deeply cherished friendship is undeniably painful. However, if you linger too long in the pain, you are the one who suffers most. Whether you aim to salvage the friendship or move on, the first and most crucial step is to let go of the past and take a step forward.

313.title: Adventurer's Potion (I)
313.content:
Recipe:

Lately, the call to explore the surface is gaining traction across Sal'thorin. Are you drawn to the sunshine, eager to embark on your own epic adventure? It's a worthy dream—just be careful not to let fantasy overshadow reality.

For patients who simply enjoy collecting a lot of gear and <style="highlight">dressing up like adventurers</style>,
they need the <style="highlight">Packrat Potion</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">wolf tails</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">etching irises</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextMedianTips><u>moderate amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">rot sludge</style>.
This potion helps patients stay level-headed, face reality, and properly prepare for the journey ahead.

The above herbs must be simmered over <style="highlight">low heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
Drink this potion before your adventure begins!

315.title: Dream Potion (I)
315.content:
Recipe:

Just as some dream of exploring the surface, others long for nothing but a quiet life at home. However, it's important to stay mindful if such desires begin to disrupt daily life.

For patients who simply <style="highlight">dislike going out</style>—so much so that even seeking treatment requires great effort,
they need the <style="highlight">Wanderlust Elixir</style>, which contains a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style>, a <link=PharmacyTextLittleTips><u>small amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">etching irises</style>, and a <link=PharmacyTextLargeTips><u>large amount</u></link> of <style="highlight">flamefern</style>.
This potion lifts their spirits and helps them rediscover the joy of going outside.

The above herbs must be boiled over <style="highlight">high heat</style> to ensure the potion's full effectiveness.
The choice between adventure and a peaceful life at home is yours to make. However, if excessive anxiety or fear starts to interfere with your daily life, a potion might be just the remedy you need!

317.title: Suspicious Letter
317.content:
To: Merlin
Dark forces may have infiltrated the Serene Lyceum. Just before the Court Mage Selection Exam, <style="highlight">the current headmaster, Leymar, died</style> under mysterious circumstances.
Someone may be trying to manipulate the selection exam, turning the campus into the center of a conspiracy.
Once you receive this letter, head to the Serene Lyceum at once. I'll explain the details when we meet.
I will be waiting at the <style="highlight">Lyceum Graveyard</style>.
Free or busy, I need you there immediately.
<align="right">Your friend, Zorya

322.title: Transfiguration Book
322.content:
Through transfiguration, you can roam the world as a quadruped or perceive tiny details as a rodent.
Silently recite the incantation and picture your chosen form in your mind. Open your pores and your heart. Let your skin sense the pulse of nature and allow your soul to resonate with the animal's spirit.
Rule 1: Transfiguration alters your physical form, but your mind remains unaffected.
Rule 2: Every creature has its own language. To understand what is indecipherable to humans, you must assume the appropriate form.
Rule 3: Transfiguration won't deprive you of reason or soul. For instance, those who transform into dolphins won't remain in the ocean forever, unless they do so and use transfiguration as an excuse.
Rule 4: There are more than four rules.
(The handbook is packed with dozens of rules and prohibitions, followed by an appendix titled "108 Emergency Measures for Common Transfiguration Mistakes", and an appendix to the appendix titled "What to Do When You Cannot Access the Handbook". There are over a hundred pages beyond that, but you decide to stop reading here.)

Silently recite the incantation and picture your chosen form in your mind. Open your pores and your heart. Let your skin sense the pulse of nature and allow your soul to resonate with the animal's spirit.
Rule 1: Transfiguration alters your physical form, but your mind remains unaffected.
Rule 2: Every creature has its own language. To understand what is indecipherable to humans, you must assume the appropriate form.
Rule 3: Transfiguration won't deprive you of reason or soul. For instance, those who transform into dolphins won't remain in the ocean forever, unless they do so and use transfiguration as an excuse.
Rule 4: There are more than four rules.
(The handbook is packed with dozens of rules and prohibitions, followed by an appendix titled "108 Emergency Measures for Common Transfiguration Mistakes", and an appendix to the appendix titled "What to Do When You Cannot Access the Handbook". There are over a hundred pages beyond that, but you decide to stop reading here.)

334.title: Observations
334.content:
I vaguely recall trekking for months along the forest paths, far to the north of the continent, where streams meet the sea. A distant mountain range rose before me.

Nestled within the mountains was a dense forest, crisscrossed by numerous streams. Large beasts were scarce; most creatures lived peacefully, feeding on plants.

The forest was often shrouded in twilight, the light dim and ethereal. Among the waters stood a towering tree, its canopy like nightfall, dotted with fireflies sparkling like stars.

It is far from here, unfortunately, or this place would have been perfect for the Wildborn and the Halians to settle in peace. <style="highlight">Those seeking a new life, unwilling to choose between blood and war, could also build their homes there.</style>

Surrounded by deep, shadowed groves, beings of different cultures and races could coexist... a <style="highlight">truly unparalleled utopia</style>.
...
(The middle section contains a few lines of inconsequential notes.)

The Arcadian Rift radiates immense magical power. If harnessed correctly, it may help me <style="highlight">achieve my ideals</style>.

Where to go, and where to return—these are questions mortals spend their lives pursuing.

The answers lie in my hands, yet I do not fully understand the questions. Much remains unfinished...
...

339.title: Autopsy Record 1
339.content:
Subject: Wild wolf, healthy
After consuming locusts, experienced extreme hunger and overeating tendencies.
Cause of Death: Starvation, malnutrition.
Condition: Emaciated, hair loss, muscle atrophy, extremely weak, abdominal pain.
Autopsy: Stomach contained minimal food remnants; mucosa congested; intestines with blood spots. Many tissue samples contained unnatural substances resembling dissected locust matter.
The "curse" may be a form of concentrated power? Locusts carry it, spreading into soil, air, and water. Transmission is unknown. Why were the Wildborn unaffected?

Subject: Male, middle-aged, long-term starvation, emaciated.
Cause of Death: Malnutrition.
...
Observation: Stomach contained minimal food remnants; unnatural substances found in tissue samples.
Unnatural substances appear linked to the curse. Could the source be divine?
Using magic to counter divine power? Next research: How to reverse the curse—title given by Merlin.

345.title: Thoughts on Magic
345.content:
The fire magic wielded by my student, Mirael, is the most lethal I've ever seen. This talent is a mixed blessing, as common folk regard her as a threat.

I wonder how ordinary people view magic. What does magic truly mean to us mages, who can harness its power?

Magic is a gift from the gods to humanity, but why is it granted only to the chosen few?

How, then, should those who possess it use the power?

Could it serve as a stepping stone for mages to ascend the ranks of society?

346.title: Monster Research
346.content:
I plan to launch a new course on monsters at school, teaching students about their physical traits, habits, combat styles, anatomy, and strategies for dealing with them.

This idea is backed by the headmaster and the majority of the academy board.
However, we disagree on including Hypofiends in the course. Clearly, it's fear that holds them back.

Anyway, I will hope for the best and prepare for the worst.

I'm going to seal all the Hypofiends I've captured so far. If this course doesn't get approved, I will continue my research in my tower.

347.title: Merlin's Diary
347.content:
Date: ??, Cloudy
Today's appointment ceremony was the most awkward thing that's ever happened to me.

Cyran made no effort to hide how pissed he was, he didn't crack a smile once. He looked at me like I'd just taken something that belonged to him.

Seriously, the student council president is directly appointed by Headmistress Heidi, I didn't even get a chance to say no.

If I'm being honest, Cyran would've been way better for the role. He's got that drive and decisiveness I completely lack, and he's got that unshakable spirit I can't seem to muster.

Maybe I can talk to the headmistress and get him to take over the job. Honestly, I'd be happy to let him do all the hard work.

348.title: New Magic Tower
348.content:
I've accepted Leymar's invitation to teach at the Lyceum, and I'm planning to build a new magic tower on campus.

Leymar generously offered me the school's old observatory as the base for my magic tower. I really like the building, particularly the huge astrolabe at the top. Maybe I could turn it into a secret room for stargazing.

Reports of Hypofiend outbreaks are pouring in from all across Esperia, which could signal the Hypogeans' return. For now, Gawain is watching over Savannah, and Mordred is pursuing another lead. If only Bedivere were here...

I thought about casting a dissenting vote, not wanting anyone close to me drawn into this turmoil. Still, the other seats were confident that Bedivere could handle the challenge. Indeed, we need her in times like these.

Could war be on the horizon? I truly hope not... but from my experience, things rarely go the way I want.

I must prepare for the worst... maybe naming my successor in advance. After all, every Merlin is directly appointed by their predecessor.

Actually, I'm not even sure why the previous Merlin chose me. What makes someone fit to become Merlin? My predecessor left me no clues. Maybe the answer will reveal itself one day.

When will that time come?

350.title: Interrogation Info
350.content:
... Based on the suspects' statements and a review of crime scene evidence, it has been preliminarily established that <style="highlight">Gervan is the perpetrator in the homicide of Leymar, former headmaster of the Serene Lyceum</style>.

Gervan claimed that he acted under duress, <style="highlight">coerced</style> by the Adamant Syndicate into stealing classified information. They had threatened to reveal his use of dark magic to treat his leg condition if he refused.

During this time, Headmaster Leymar discovered the truth about Gervan's legs by chance and suspected that he was colluding with the Adamant Syndicate to manipulate the court mage selection exam.

Headmaster Leymar then spoke with Gervan, urging him to sever his ties with the Adamant Syndicate. Shocked that the headmaster knew the truth, Gervan, in a moment of panic, killed him with the magic he had learned from the Adamant Syndicate.

... At present, there is <style="highlight">no</style> conclusive evidence establishing Cyran as the mastermind behind the crime. Gervan's testimony alone is insufficient to convict the esteemed Chief Court Mage.

On the other hand, it is concerning that Zorya's <style="highlight">release is being opposed</style> by several nobles on the grounds of insufficient exculpatory evidence. Unfortunately, the royal family cannot enforce her release without upsetting the balance of power in the court. I will <style="highlight">continue the investigation</style> for further proof to clear Zorya's name.

352.title: Teaching Journal
352.content:
The headmaster has come up with yet another rule, mandating that all professors keep a teaching log.
I don't mind, actually. It'll be a nice way to keep track of all the fun and happy moments on campus...
...
The textbook "Introduction to Magic" is way too boring. It's all theory and basic spells.
So, I taught my students some fun spells beyond the syllabus. They finally showed some interest!
...
Oh no. The kids have been messing around with these spells in other classes. A few professors have come to confront me about it...
Professor Herbert is one of them. He said some students cast a hair growth spell on the greenhouse plants, causing them to grow out of control and eventually burst through the classroom walls.
Professor Sybin arrived later to complain about his colorful moustache, the work of a student who had used a color-changing spell...
Wait, another professor's at the door. I'll have to stop here.

Today in class, I introduced a spell that elevates the flavor of desserts.
This spell is one of my favorite creations, though some dismiss it as impractical. But isn't magic meant to bring joy? A spell that makes desserts more enjoyable can hardly be called useless.
The students were fascinated by it, so I promised to bring some desserts to the next class for a live demonstration.
...
The spell worked flawlessly, but the results weren't perfect. Apparently, not everyone shares my sweet tooth. The desserts were too cloying for the students...
In the end, I had to take all the desserts home. I really doubt I can finish thirty pieces of cake by myself in two days...

353.title: Messy Journal
353.content:
Now that the semester break is here and my research is all wrapped up, it's time for a long trip.
At the beach, I caught ten big fish and had a barbecue party with the nearby anglers.
...
While hiking through a mountain, I kept hearing voices calling out to me. It turned out to be a parrot that had learned to speak from a Wilder!
...
The weather in the desert was terrible. One moment, the sky was clear, and the next, a sandstorm swept in, turning the sky hazy.
Even magic couldn't remove the dust on my rucksack.
Yet in this harsh environment, an upbeat community of orphans made their home here.
The children were so optimistic and innocent. When the sandstorm tore through their camps, they didn't cry. Instead, they invited me to lie on the sand and watch the stars with them.
Before leaving, I transformed the desert into an oasis. May those trees thrive forever, keeping this little haven safe on my behalf...

I messed up and bought the wrong ingredients. Because of that, Cyran couldn't finish his assignment, and now he has been glaring at me nonstop. It is really hard to concentrate when someone is staring like they want to hex you.

Maybe I should make something delicious for him with the ingredients on hand? They're all edible anyway.
...
I ended up brewing a very sugary potion. I thought it was great. Apparently, I was the only one. The professor warned me not to poison my classmates, which feels a little unfair. Cyran has not stopped shooting daggers at me either.

Hoping to find a kindred spirit, I asked him about it. He said he had simply poured it out because it was too disgusting. Just like that. Rude.

355.title: Review Plan
355.content:
The semester's coming to an end. It's time to buckle down and study!

Today's Agenda
Morning: Illusion practical exam; Afternoon: Study magical theory with Cyran at the library and complete the paper; Evening: Conduct alchemy research and finalize the potion recipe summary.
...
My plan flopped. While doing research in the library, I came across a book titled "100 Serene Lyceum Secrets". Who could resist a title like that?

I ended up spending most of the day reading that book. Right before the library closed, I asked Cyran for his notes.

As expected, his face went dark immediately. He started lecturing me at full speed. I could barely follow half of it.

He kept going on about the same thing, accusing me of slacking just because I'm already at the top of the class... and honestly, I can't remember the rest.

Anyway, I still managed to get his notes and stayed up all night to finish everything. I'm completely worn out now. Definitely sleeping in tomorrow.
