622.title: Lost Voice Script
622.content:
Role:
Charlene: Female lead. She hails from House Danwell, a viscount's family whose fortunes declined after her father's death.
Rande: Male lead. A commoner who lives in the forest.
Wilbert: Charlene's uncle, who inherited the viscountcy from his late elder brother. In pursuit of wealth, he tried to marry Charlene and Jenna off to the elderly Count Lorenzo.
Jenna: Wilbert's daughter and Charlene's cousin. After Charlene left the family, Wilbert arranged for Jenna to marry Count Lorenzo in her place.
Joe: Jenna's current classmate, who becomes her lover seven years later.

Scene 1
- Setting: Danwell Abbey (now fallen into disrepair)
- Music: Melancholic prelude (strings)
- Charlene appears by a dilapidated fountain, sobbing.
Charlene: You left us so suddenly, Father. The family is struggling in your absence.
- Charlene performs a solo: The Withered Rose.
- Wilbert enters.
Wilbert: There you are, my poor dear. I've been looking all over for you.
Charlene: Uncle Wilbert...
- Wilbert performs a solo: Fallen Family.
Wilbert: You must gather yourself, for the sake of the family.
Charlene: Do I really have to marry Count Lorenzo... He's thirty years older than me.
Wilbert: Your marriage could save our family from ruin. This is your fate, Charlene. Surely you are clever enough to understand what must be done.
- Wilbert exits, leaving Charlene sitting alone in helpless despair.
- Jenna enters and tiptoes over.
Jenna: Charlene.
Charlene: Oh, Jenna. Come over here.
- Jenna wipes away Charlene's tears, and Charlene pulls her into an embrace. Together, they perform a duet: Bleak Future.
Charlene: You should go home, Jenna. Don't let Uncle Wilbert worry about you.
Charlene: I need somewhere quiet... to think about the future of our family.

Scene 2
- Setting: Luminous Woods (misty)
- Music: Song with an air of mystery (flute + harp)
- Charlene enters, wandering through the forest as she performs a solo: Silent Monologue.
Charlene: Who's there?!
- Rande enters, standing awkwardly at one side of the stage.
Rande: My apologies, I didn't mean to interrupt, but...
Rande: Are you crying?
Charlene: I'm fine... Maybe I should leave.
- Charlene turns around and prepares to leave.
Rande: Hold on!
- Rande hurries to center stage and reaches out to Charlene. He then performs a solo: The Guiding Light.
- Together, Rande and Charlene perform a duet: Into the Light.
Rande: Come with me.
- Rande takes Charlene by the arm, and they exit together.

Scene 3
- Setting: Hidden garden (night)
- Music: Lighthearted tune (woodwinds)
- Rande leads Charlene into a hidden garden, and the two enter the stage together.
- Charlene steps forward, captivated by the scenery.
Charlene: What is this place...
- Rande performs a solo: Healing Voice.
- Rande slowly walks up behind Charlene, and she turns to face him.
- As they sing Our Hearts as One together, they gradually draw closer and take each other's hands. Charlene rests her head on Rande's shoulder.
Charlene: You have a point, Rande. Since Uncle Wilbert inherited the title, the burden of restoring our family should fall upon him.
Rande: That's right. If your father were alive, he'd never have married you off to that old count.
Rande: To be honest, I have my own reasons for helping you too...
Charlene: What do you mean?
- Rande performs a solo: All I Ever Wanted.
- Rande kneels on one knee and offers Charlene a red flower.
Rande: Charlene, would you spend the rest of your life with me?
Charlene: Sure!
- They wrap their arms around each other.

Scene 4
- Setting: Forest (night)
- Music: Fast-paced music for a sense of urgency (strings)
- Charlene makes her entrance, scrambling in panic from one side of the stage to the other
Wilbert: Charlene, how could you be so selfish?!
- Wilbert storms onto the stage and grabs Charlene.
Wilbert: Come back with me! Count Lorenzo's still waiting for his bride!
Charlene: No!
- Charlene tries to break free, but Wilbert drags her away with him.
Wilbert: You have no right to refuse! I can't let my Jenna darling marry that old man in your stead!
Rande: Let her go!
- Wilbert pauses, and Charlene turns around.
- Rande enters, <style="highlight">angrily brushing Wilbert's hands away</style> and stepping in front of Charlene.
- Rande and Wilbert perform a duet: Wrong Path.
- Rande and Charlene slowly retreat as the duet continues.
Wilbert: Stop right there!
- Suddenly, Wilbert lunges forward to grab Charlene, but Rande <style="highlight">casts a spell to stop him</style>.
Rande: Charlene is not going back with you! She should not have to sacrifice her happiness for the sake of your greed!
Rande: Let's go, Charlene.
- Rande leads Charlene <style="highlight">offstage</style>. Wilbert struggles to his feet and glares resentfully at them.
Wilbert: Hmph... You two will pay for this!
- Wilbert exits, wounded.


Scene 5
- Setting: Cliffside (heavy rain + lightning)
- Music: Vigorous beats for a sense of conflict and danger (percussion + strings)
- Rande enters, looking anxious. He runs to the edge of the cliff and looks down, then quickly turns back.
- Wilbert struts onto the stage, leading Count Lorenzo's guards.
Wilbert: Why have you stopped running, you foolish, arrogant boy?
Wilbert: These guards serve Count Lorenzo. Only a man of his means can give Charlene a good life and help restore our family's fortunes.
Rande: Enough. This was never about Charlene, much less your family. It has always been about your greed.
Wilbert: Say whatever you like... You'll never see Charlene again anyway.
- Wilbert performs a solo: Righteous Act.
Wilbert: Guards! That lecher's been making advances on the Count's fiancée! Seize him!
- At Wilbert's signal, the armed guards close in on Rande.
- Rande keeps backing away until he reaches the edge of the cliff and stops.
- Rande and Wilbert perform a duet: Fate.
Wilbert: Kill him!
- The guards brandish their weapons.
-Rande straightens up, looking resolute.
Rande: Forgive me, Charlene... I can't fulfill my promise to you.
- Rande jumps off the cliff, sending the guards reeling back in shock.
- Wilbert strides to the edge of the cliff and peers down. A smile creeps up to his face.
Wilbert: I'm Viscount Danwell! Those who defy me must die!

Scene 6
- Setting: Rande's grave in Luminous Woods (misty)
- Music: Sorrowful, slow-paced music (strings)
- Charlene collapses before Rande's grave, tears streaming down her face. She performs a solo: Don't Leave Me.
- Rande (background) and Charlene perform a duet: Lost Voice.
- As white petals drift down from above, the curtain falls. (Original ending; omitted from this performance.)
Charlene: I've decided to leave my family, Rande... How I wish you were still here by my side.
- Charlene leans against Rande's grave and slowly drifts off to sleep. (New)

Scene 7 (New)
- Setting: Rande's grave in Luminous Woods (Clear sky and dawn is beginning to break)
- Music: Wistful solo that swells into a feeling of spiritual release (flute)
- While Charlene is sleeping at Rande's grave, Rande performs a solo in the background: Final Guidance.
- Carried on the breeze, a red flower spirals down and comes to rest in Charlene's lap.
- Charlene opens her eyes and picks up the flower. Slowly, she rises to her feet, a bittersweet expression on her face.
Charlene: Rande, is this a message from you?
- Charlene rises and performs a solo: Echoes of the Soul.
- Charlene turns around to face Rande's grave.
Charlene: Can I become a guiding light for those who are lost, just as you were for me?
- Charlene slowly steps back, her sorrow giving way to resolve. Then, she turns around and leaves.

Scene 8 (New)
- Setting: Palace ballroom
- Music: Waltz prelude
- Jenna, dressed in a bridal gown, sits at the dressing table in tears.
- Wilbert enters and gently rests his hands on Jenna's shoulders. Together, they perform a duet: Perfect Match.
- Jenna circles the stage, trying to escape Wilbert's control.
Wilbert: Jenna!
- Jenna stops in her tracks with her back to Wilbert.
- Wilbert strides forward and grips Jenna tightly by the arm. He then performs a solo: Pride of Nobility.
- Wilbert drags Jenna back to the dressing table and forces her to sit down.
Wilbert: Accept your fate, my darling.
- Wilbert exits, leaving Jenna in tears before the mirror.
Jenna: Fate... Why must you be so cruel to me?!
- Jenna slumps over the dressing table, weeping. Suddenly, someone knocks on the window.
Charlene: Jenna! Jenna!
- Jenna looks up at the window and rises in disbelief.
- Charlene enters in a black cloak, rushes over, and hugs Jenna tightly.
Jenna: Oh, Charlene! Have you come to take me away from this prison?
Charlene: Don't worry, I'll get you out of here.
- Charlene and Jenna perform a duet: At Fate's Mercy
Jenna: Charlene, I'm so sorry for all the hurtful things I said about you and Rande...
Charlene: That's not important now.
Charlene: Put this on. We need to leave as soon as possible.
- Jenna puts on a cloak and follows Charlene out. They both exit.

Scene 9 (New)
- Setting: Modest garden (sunny)
- Music: Calm prelude (organ)
- Seven years have passed. Jenna enters with a group of children.
Jenna: Take your places, everyone!
- The children stand in two rows, falling silent as they turn their attention to Jenna.
Jenna: Today is Charlene's birthday, so I expect everyone to be on their best behavior. Understood?
Children: Understood!
Charlene: Jenna?
Jenna: Oh, she's coming!

623.title: Pipp's Diary
623.content:
Mama told me a story today.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who wanted to become a mage. He believed that with magic, he could have everything he ever wished for. Then he met a kind old lady, who offered him a magic potion that could make his wish come true. All he had to do was drink it and sleep for a whole day. The potion couldn't turn him into a mage, but it granted him amazing abilities, like flying, diving deep underwater, and even hanging upside down from a cliff!

Mama asked me if I wanted to be like the little boy in the story, not having to worry about anything in life. Of course I said yes! Then she told me <style="highlight">Baba Muriel would use magic to make my wish come true the next day.</style>. As long as I drank the potion and went to sleep, <style="highlight">I'd wake up the next day as an adorable cat, just like Papa</style>.

I wonder what I'll look like! I can't wait to find out!

624.title: I'm Good!
624.content:
My dearest Sandora, how have you been?

Sorry it's taken me so long to write! It took a while to find a traveling merchant willing to carry this letter to you.

You miss me a lot, don't you? For the record, I'm doing great here!

I love being a Graveborn! I can run and jump without any trouble, and every day I get to do all the things I love. I'm happier now than I ever was when I was alive!

The only fly in the ointment is that I can no longer spend time with you.

Actually... death's not so bad, if you think about it. Just a reunion with everyone who got there first. Kind of takes the edge off, doesn't it? Haha.

Ah, enough gloomy talk about death! Guess what? I'm getting ready to move to a new place!

Point is, I'm living my best life here, so don't worry about me, okay?

Forever yours, Sabrine

P.S. My new address is <style="highlight">1, West Ossuary Square, Novaris</style>. There's a giant tree right next to my new home!

If we have the chance to meet again, be sure to come visit me!

Point is, I'm living my best life here, so don't worry about me, okay?

Forever yours, Sabrine

P.S. My new address is <style="highlight">1, West Ossuary Square, Novaris</style>. There's a giant tree right next to my new home!

If we have the chance to meet again, be sure to come visit me!

每当我看着<male>他</male><female>她</female>站在高塔之上，轻描淡写地修正那些足以让凡人发狂的魔法漏洞时，我的血液里仿佛有千万只毒虫在啃噬。
<male>他</male><female>她</female>那傲慢的慈悲，那种对力量游刃有余的掌控感，无一不在嘲讽着我——嘲讽我这半生为了摸索真理边缘而付出的惨烈代价。
我嫉妒<male>他</male><female>她</female>，嫉妒到发狂。我多想亲手撕碎<male>他</male><female>她</female>的优雅，将<male>他</male><female>她</female>那高洁的灵魂一点点剥扯开来，看那双深邃平静的眼睛里染上绝望与痛苦的底色……

<male>他</male><female>她</female>像是一个深不见底的渊口，无论投入多么暴戾的黑暗魔法，<male>他</male><female>她</female>都能将其同化、平复，甚至<style="highlight">逆向转化为纯粹的生命本源</style>。
这启发了我：既然<male>他</male><female>她</female>的身体是一个完美的<style="highlight">转化器</style>，为什么不让<male>他</male><female>她</female>成为那个替所有牺牲者承载痛苦的受体呢？

通过改造术式的底层逻辑，我可以建立一条隐秘的<style="highlight">生命力与魔力的置换通道</style>。当施术者试图施展那些逆转生死、违背常理的禁咒时，产生的剧烈反噬与寿命衰减将不再作用于施术者本身。法阵会强制抽取梅林那庞大纯净的魔力与生命力，将其<style="highlight">滤化为结果注入受益者体内</style>。
而施术的代价——那些残疾、衰老、折损寿命以及灵魂被撕裂的剧痛，将顺着法阵，悉数倒灌入梅林的灵魂深处！

我将这一完美的置换仪式称为<style="highlight">救世主的加冕</style>。
<male>他</male><female>她</female>既然那么爱拯救世人，那么我就帮<male>他</male><female>她</female>一把——我要让这位魔法师协会的“首席”，在无尽的黑暗中替所有人流血，成为我通向神明领域的、最完美的垫脚石！
626.content_male:
I must admit, M is the ultimate masterpiece the Gods have bestowed upon this world. Within that flawless body flows magic as pure as starlight.

Whenever I watch him standing atop the high tower, effortlessly fixing catastrophic magical anomalies that would drive ordinary mortals mad, I find myself unable to look away. My blood burns as if devoured by a thousand stinging insects.

His arrogant charity, his effortless control over absolute power... It all mocks me. It mocks the horrific price I have paid over half my life just to scrape at the mere edges of Truth.

I envy him. I hate him to the point of absolute madness. How I long to shatter his perfect elegance with my own hands. I want to tear his noble soul apart piece by piece, just to see those calm, deep eyes finally drown in despair and agony...

Fortunately, all dark magic demands a price. That law is absolute.

Through my long observations, I discovered that M's soul structure is freakishly unique. His magic circuits possess an incredible <style="highlight">Vortex Assimilation</style> property.

He is like a bottomless abyss. No matter how violent or corrupt the dark magic thrown at him may be, he can absorb and purify it, even <style="highlight">reversing the corruption into pure life force</style>.

This gave me a wonderful idea. Since his body is the perfect <style="highlight">vessel for purification</style>, why not make him the one who bears everyone else's agony?

By rewriting the core logic of the spell, I can forge a secret <style="highlight">Transference Conduit</style>. Whenever a dark mage casts forbidden curses to cheat death or rewrite reality, the violent backlash will no longer hit the caster. Instead, the magic circle will forcibly drain M's vast reserves of pure mana and life force, <style="highlight">purifying it to fuel the caster's spell</style>.

Meanwhile, the true price of forbidden magic: the crippling injuries, accelerated aging, shortened lifespan, and the agonizing pain of a shredded soul... All of it will flow backward through the conduit, directly into the depths of M's soul!

I have named this perfect ritual: <style="highlight">The Savior's Coronation</style>.

Since he loves saving the world so much, then I shall help him fulfill that wish. I'll make the Arcane Council's grand First Seat bleed for eternity in the dark, carrying the burdens of countless others. And when at last those eyes are filled with suffering, he will become the perfect stepping stone on my path toward becoming a God.

627.content:
Report compiled by: Kraff
 
 Annotated by: Cyran
Regarding the border disturbances and illegal smuggling detailed in this report, bury it for now. Do not report this to the upper management.

The royal capital is currently preparing for the <style="highlight">Ascension Festival</style>, a political undertaking of utmost importance intended to showcase the empire's prosperity and reassure the populace. At this time, we cannot let border rumors and minor skirmishes ruin the festive atmosphere.

As for the questionable activities of certain merchant guilds, Internal Affairs will handle matters separately.
Cyran

--------------------------------------------------



[Border Unrest and the Smuggling Network]
Recent surveillance indicates frequent unrest along the border between the Lightbearer Empire and Bantus. The undead within Bantus appear to be experiencing an unusual agitation. Accompanying this phenomenon is the emergence of several "merchant guilds" on the border running an extremely dangerous smuggling enterprise in secret.
Drawing upon primitive shamanic practices passed down through generations, they assist civilians, smugglers, and even fugitives in crossing the border and entering Bantus territory.

[Smuggling Method: The Undead Disguise Ritual]
Any living person seeking entry into the Bantus Empire must first erase every trace of life from themselves. The ritual is crude and deeply unsettling:

Ashen Mask: The smugglers mix the ashes of murder victims with black swamp mud, smearing it over their faces and bodies to completely mask the scent of living flesh.
Deathly Slumber: They chew a toxic border herb known as corpsefern, inducing a coma that mimics death.
Soul Anchoring: The guiding shaman strikes the subject's head using a ritual implement crafted from beast bone, before pressing a splinter of grave-soiled bone beneath their tongue. This acts as a "beacon" for the drifting soul, ensuring their consciousness isn't blown away.

Once the ritual is complete, the subject's heartbeat and body temperature disappear entirely. Even their soul signature becomes indistinguishable from that of a true undead. By assuming this <style="highlight">undead state</style>, they can pass the gaze of Bantus' guards without suspicion.



[Limitations and Fatal Consequences]
Time Restriction: A soul may remain within Bantus for only a limited period. The exact duration varies depending on the ritual used.

Irreversibility: If the soul remains separated from the body for too long, the life essence that binds flesh and spirit together will wither and decay.

Final Outcome: Once that life essence is severed entirely, the subject becomes trapped forever in the <style="highlight">undead state</style>. Their physical body becomes a rotting, empty shell, while their soul is torn apart by the death winds of Bantus and dissolves into nothingness.

629.title: An Overview of Magical Theory
629.content:
...
Whatever school a living mage chooses, their magic gradually becomes bound to their life force. Gravecalling is the sole exception—death energy is incompatible with life, so this bond can never form.
When a mage dies, any life-bound magic dies with them. Should they rise as Graveborn, that life-bound magic may vanish completely or remain sealed beyond reach. Only magic that never formed the bond can still be used.
Fortunately, this need not be permanent. By studying gravecalling, a Graveborn mage can reshape the bond and eventually reclaim the magical power they held in life. From then on, however, every spell must be built on gravecalling principles.
(The rest contains nothing useful.)

634.title: Soul Forge Feasibility Report
634.content:
Project Overview:
Recreate the main function of Bantus' lost Graveborn relic and use a controlled magical ritual to convert the living into Graveborn.

Technical Basis:
Gravecalling draws on <style="highlight">death energy</style>. Converting a living person into Graveborn requires a large and stable supply of it. The Soul Forge creates a temporary field that gathers death energy from the surrounding world, concentrates it, and channels it into the subject.
The lost Graveborn relic worked in much the same way. However, <style="highlight">it already held a large reserve of death energy</style>, so it could perform the conversion more easily.

Soul Forge Design:
Control Room: Used to activate the Soul Forge.
Altar: Where the living subject stands during the conversion.
Protective Barrier: Separates the control room from the altar. If the concentrated death energy reaches nearby Graveborn, it could kill them a second time and erase them completely.

Risk Warning:
<style="highlight">Once the conversion begins, it cannot be stopped.</style> In addition, the <style="highlight">altar is extremely fragile</style> and must be protected throughout the ritual. No effective way to reinforce it has yet been found.

636.title: Shared Journal
636.content:
(The journal contains two different handwriting styles, one noticeably messier than the other.)

Bessie, I'm sorry for hurting you... Nothing I say now can make it right... I'm so, so sorry.

Don't be too hard on yourself, Hilda! All sorts of strange things can happen under a full moon. I don't blame you.

I couldn't control myself! The voice in my head kept telling me to kill everyone!

You are not alone! The same thing's happening to everyone! None of this is your fault, and I hope you can stay strong.

I don't know how much longer I can keep this up.

Baba Muriel's learning how to replace limbs. Until she figures it out, you just have to hold on!

Don't bother coming anymore, Bessie. I can't even recognize you. There's no hope for me.

Bessie... <s>please, just stay away</s>.

<s>Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!</s>

(The remaining text is illegible)

637.content:
Ever since my memory started slipping, I've been hiding away in this tree hollow.

The terrain makes this place hard for others to reach. And the barriers Bessie and I built make it just as hard for me to escape.

Bessie refuses to give up on me, so she still comes to visit from time to time. But I worry it's too dangerous, so I suggested we keep in touch through a shared journal instead.

I don't want to hurt her. I know exactly what's going to happen to me.

It's only been two days since I saw her, and already her face is blurring in my mind...

I must remind her to reinforce the barriers...

What is... her name again...

638.title: How to Create a Memory Star
638.content:
Memory Stars record past scenes from the user's perspective, but not their inner thoughts.
Without the enchanting device, Memory Stars can still be created using the following method:
1. The mage performing the memory extraction, segmentation, or preservation spells must have graduated from the Serene Lyceum with an overall grade of "Excellent" and hold the endorsement of at least two faculty members.
2. The storage medium must be made from <style="highlight">highly stable magical materials</style> and thoroughly insulated to ensure it does not deteriorate for at least three hundred years.
3. Prepare <style="highlight">chronostatin</style> in advance to seal the Memory Fragments.
4. Multiple types of <style="highlight">arcane reagents</style> are required to aid the spellcasting process. Without them, enchanting the Memory Star will be extremely difficult.
5. While the spell is being cast, the memory's owner must maintain unwavering focus and resolve. Their emotional state must closely mirror that of the recorded memory to prevent emotional backlash.
6. Memory extraction must take place in a quiet, secure environment. When the spell is cast on another person, the spellcaster should be mentally prepared to experience the same emotions as the memory's owner.
7. A calming elixir must be consumed immediately after extraction to prevent lingering emotions and sensory confusion.
8. Each Memory Star can store only one scene. It must be imbued with magic before the memory can be viewed.
9. Memory Stars can be carved into any shape you like—just not bottles or jars!

642.title: Book
642.content:
A yellowed book. On the cover, a skeleton holds up a finger beside the words "Death Is No Excuse for Bad Manners."

100 Things Every New Graveborn Should Know
1. Novaris has no sun, but somehow we still have the phrase "pulling an all-nighter." Why? Well, the Graveborn don't need sleep. I suppose that makes every night an all-nighter.
2. If an eyeball falls out, pick it up and blow off the dust. It'll still work if you put it back the wrong way. You'll just see things from a different angle.
3. Creaking joints mean you're due for an oiling. They are not an invitation to see who can rattle the longest.
...
You skip straight to the last page.
100. Forget the other 99 rules. As long as you don't fall apart, you can enjoy a long and happy life in Novaris—or whatever passes for a life when you're already dead.

643.title: Crumpled Paper
643.content:
(A sheet of parchment, soaked in seawater and left to dry. The handwriting is a crooked scrawl.)
A hand reached up from below the rail.
Then another. Then dozens more. Pale green and white, as though all the drowned souls beneath us had come looking for someone to take their place.
Old Nick spotted them first. Said something was scratching at the bottom of the hull. We laughed at him.
By midnight, the hands had reached the hull. Nails scraped against the planks. The sound set our teeth on edge.
We hacked at them. There were always more.
They took their time. Whenever one let go, another took its place. They held the ship fast. We couldn't get away.
The captain ordered us to throw the cargo overboard. We did. They didn't want it.
Then the raw meat. Over it went. They didn't want that either.
Still the hands writhed and clawed, desperately feeling for something.
I don't know what they're looking for.
But tonight, they'll reach my boots.

644.title: A Guide to Life in Twilight Village
644.content:
1. On a full moon, stay indoors and keep your door shut. Whatever you hear, do not open it.
2. Animals behaving like people is perfectly normal. Pay them no mind.
3. Humanoid Graveborn have two hands and two feet. Only the feet touch the ground. They do not have excessive body hair or fur. If you do not match this description, please disregard this rule. Enjoy your peaceful life here.

645.title: Research Notes
645.content:
During the full moon, the power of death in Novaris rises like a tide.
Whirlpools form in the lake. The surge of magic sends monsters into a frenzy. Hilda chases anyone she sees.
Gravecalling magic is more powerful under a full moon, but that power comes with a serious drawback—spells become unpredictable.
Think of a spell as a path. Normally, it runs straight. Under a full moon, that same path splits. Try to send the spell left, and it veers right.
Casting spells under a full moon is therefore extremely dangerous. Further research is needed. Do not attempt it without proper precautions.

The painting shows a dark gray sea crowded with half-sunken boats, all pointing toward the horizon. An indistinct figure sits at each bow.
Artist: Wilko Dempayne
Inspiration: I watched the ship that had taken my life sink slowly to the seabed. I had no breath left even for a sigh.

Inspiration: On the first full moon after his death, he finally understood light. It was merely a way of measuring the dark.

653.title: Message in a Bottle
653.content:
Dear stranger,
By the time you find this, I'll probably be gone.
When I learned how ill I was, I couldn't take it in. Death was something that happened to other people. Surely it couldn't be happening to me.
I'd always been lucky. Every bet I made went my way, and I never lost a coin at the card table. Then I sat down across from the God of Death with my life at stake, and there wasn't a thing I could do to win.
But here's a thought, my friend. What if life was only ever a loan from the God of Death? Perhaps mine has simply come due. I find that a little easier to accept.
I wonder who you are. Whoever finds this, I suppose a reply is out of the question.
When you've finished reading, my friend, please put this letter back in its bottle and send it out to sea. Let it drift wherever the current takes it. Isn't that what we've all been doing, in our own way?

655.title: Scribbled Note
655.content:
After several days of observation, I believe this site is used for a ritual. It appears to begin by touching the brazier, then lighting the candles in a particular order.
The order matters. Something about the arrangement suggests a connection to the phases of the moon... Unfortunately, I have not been able to test every possibility.
If anyone finds these notes, try the following:
Touch the brazier, then light the candle at the foot of the ruined wall <style="highlight">farthest east</style>. Next, light the one <style="highlight">in the middle</style>, followed by the one <style="highlight">in the southeast corner</style>.
There seems to be a time limit. Work quickly.
I can't promise this will work. I won't have another chance to try.
If it succeeds, something should appear in the brazier... May the God of Death watch over you.

657.title: Forgotten Notes
657.content:
Well, my friend! Looking for death? Or something powerful enough to put you out of your misery? Ha! You've come to the right place.
This stranded merchant ship has a sorry tale to tell. Every soul aboard refused to die. Every one of them tried to escape. All for nothing... Here they remain, trapped and struggling.
Now they wander restlessly, following the same paths over and over. <style="highlight">When a ghost passes beneath the lantern, death will reveal itself...</style>
Good luck, my friend. May death smile upon you. Heh heh heh...

Don't ask me why. All I know is, that's the only way to make the thing appear.

659.title: Marl's Letter
659.content:
My name is Marl, first mate of the Tempest. If this letter is ever found, let it tell the truth of what happened aboard. The sea must not be allowed to swallow Captain Loyd's crimes along with the rest of us.
This voyage brought us far more treasure than we ever expected. But Captain Loyd tried to keep it all for himself. When the crew discovered what he was doing, he lashed out and began plotting a vile murder.
He held Bentley's sister and Clarisa's parents hostage back on shore, forcing our doctor and chef to poison the crew. Once most of us were dead, he planned to kill them too and leave no one alive who knew the truth.
Bentley and Clarisa couldn't bring themselves to follow his orders to the end. They secretly gave unpoisoned meals to me and <style="highlight">Sharu, our mechanic</style>, sparing us from the fate of the others. Now, we must find a way to stop Loyd from sailing home alone and seek help from the Syndicate.
I'll steer the Tempest into the reefs and force her to drop anchor. While Loyd is distracted, Sharu will slip into the fire room and shut down the engines. With the ship dead in the water, Loyd will have no choice but to contact the Syndicate for help. If he tries to stop us... I may have to kill him.
If I don't make it, Sharu will be the last person who knows the whole truth. If he dies too, this letter must speak for us.

<align="right">May the sea protect the brave and the honest.
<align="right">First Mate Marl

660.content:
1. Agatha's Stormtamer: A silver crown set with an enormous sapphire. Said to calm smaller storms. Marl traded one of his scimitars for it with a tribal chief.
2. Immortal Heart: An egg-sized jewel recovered from an underwater cavern. In darkness, its light pulses steadily like a beating heart.
3. Birdsong Aria: A necklace made from seven exquisite shells, arranged by size and bound with jellyfish silk. Beside it lies a card written in a delicate hand: "May the depths forever keep you safe, my captain."

661.title: Fire Room Notes
661.content:
(Much of the writing has been weathered by the sea breeze, but the operating instructions are still clear.)
Follow these steps exactly when operating the fire room valve:
First, fit the <style="highlight">custom gear</style> into the slot. Wait until it clicks into place before proceeding.
Next, turn the valve wheel <style="highlight">clockwise</style> until it stops. This will close the inner gate.
Finally, turn the wheel <style="highlight">counterclockwise</style> until you hear air flowing in. Wait for the hissing to stop. Once the pressure has equalized, the door is safe to open.

663.title: Engine Manual
663.content:
This is one of the first vessels of a new model. It delivers excellent performance, though its stability is still being improved.
<style="highlight">CRITICAL WARNING: AVOID HEAVY IMPACTS</style>
Note: The hull may not absorb a severe impact safely. A collision with reefs, large sea creatures, or another vessel could cause the propulsion system to surge out of control and even <style="highlight">trigger a small explosion</style>.
Advice: Whenever possible, <style="highlight">keep clear of reef fields</style> and waters frequented by large sea creatures. If a collision occurs, reduce speed immediately.

667.title: Sentencing Record
667.content:
This sentencing record lists the living prisoners brought to the flower fields for execution over several centuries.

Name: Laena Norris
Charges: Provided food, lodging, and cover for undercover Lightbearer spies while employed at an inn. Discovered during a search by our soldiers.
Statement Excerpt: "I don't know anything. And if I did, I wouldn't tell you. You rattling heaps of bones..." (What follows is so foul that you are astonished the Bantus clerk recorded every word.)
Interrogation Notes: Seven consecutive days without food or water. Has named no accomplices. Responses consist solely of abuse directed at the interrogator.

Name: Marcus Wayne (Male. Aged 38 at death. Claimed to be a cloth merchant.)
Charges: Three maps of Novaris' defenses, annotated with guard rotation times, were found in a hidden compartment in his cargo. Intelligence reports indicate direct contact with Lightbearer intelligence.
Statement Excerpt: "I came here to sell cloth. That's all I know. Kill me if you want. Lightbearers aren't afraid to die."
Interrogation Notes: Refuses to confess.

Clerk's Annotation: The prisoners listed above remain fanatically loyal to the Lightbearers and refuse to divulge any information. Under Article 148 of the Bantus Military Code, such prisoners are ineligible for conversion to Graveborn. They are to be executed and their remains destroyed.
Conversion is intended to provide usable labor or military recruits. These individuals would remain bound to their Lightbearer beliefs even in death. Turning them into Graveborn would only create a security risk.

Statement Excerpt: "I don't know anything. And if I did, I wouldn't tell you. You rattling heaps of bones..." (What follows is so foul that you are astonished the Bantus clerk recorded every word.)
Interrogation Notes: Seven consecutive days without food or water. Has named no accomplices. Responses consist solely of abuse directed at the interrogator.

Name: Marcus Wayne (Male. Aged 38 at death. Claimed to be a cloth merchant.)
Charges: Three maps of Novaris' defenses, annotated with guard rotation times, were found in a hidden compartment in his cargo. Intelligence reports indicate direct contact with Lightbearer intelligence.
Statement Excerpt: "I came here to sell cloth. That's all I know. Kill me if you want. Lightbearers aren't afraid to die."
Interrogation Notes: Refuses to confess.

Clerk's Annotation: The prisoners listed above remain fanatically loyal to the Lightbearers and refuse to divulge any information. Under Article 148 of the Bantus Military Code, such prisoners are ineligible for conversion to Graveborn. They are to be executed and their remains destroyed.
Conversion is intended to provide usable labor or military recruits. These individuals would remain bound to their Lightbearer beliefs even in death. Turning them into Graveborn would only create a security risk.

669.title: Journal
669.content:
(You brush away the dust. It appears to be an old diary.)
Day 1
The mistress spent another eight hours in the greenhouse today. Hodge, the gardener, says she's growing a new kind of flower. She's calling it "Night Iris." Deep purple petals that glow in the dark, apparently.
I've never seen a flower that glows. It must be beautiful.

Day 5
Oh, you won't believe this! I took tea to the study last night and caught the mistress talking to a flowerpot. Something about "If only she'd spare me a second glance..."
Dura above! Is she in love?

Day 8
I've found out! She met a famous actress at that banquet in Lightbearer territory. They say the woman is so beautiful she hardly looks real. The mistress couldn't take her eyes off her. As soon as she got home, she started growing those flowers.
Just how beautiful must she be to make the mistress fall head over heels?

Day 19
The flowers are nearly ready to bloom. The mistress has been in such a good mood lately. We broke a plate and she didn't even scold us.

Day 30
I heard the mistress humming today. Her flowers have finally bloomed, they say. She hummed as she wrapped up a bouquet, and was still humming when she left.
She's back. No humming now. She looked awful, and those flowers she once treasured above all else were tossed on the floor.
They were too lovely to leave there. I slipped a petal into my apron pocket, and I can still smell its perfume. It really does give off a little glow at night. I love it.
If only I were that beautiful woman she was courting, instead of a blood thrall... I know I would've said yes!

671.title: Unknown Diary
671.content:
Day 1
The ship's broken apart. Everyone's gone. Just me and the wreck, washed up somewhere I don't know.
My leg's broken. I can't stand. But my hands still work. I can crawl.
No food. No fresh water. What am I supposed to do?
Day 2
I'm so hungry. Not even a blade of grass here. I'm going to starve.
Please, someone. Help me.
Day 3
Why isn't it morning yet? Is there no sun here?
Day 4
I'm dying of thirst... Dura, please, let it rain. Please... have mercy on me!
Day 5
Leg's swollen. Hands too.
Still breathing, though. Damn it. Still breathing.
Day 6
Thought I heard someone call my name today. Turned around. Nothing.
Must be the hunger. Hearing things.
Day 7
Drank a little seawater. Felt like knives going down my throat.
Don't drink it again. Don't drink it again. Don't drink it again.
Day 8
It hurts to be alive.
God... Goddess... Dura... whoever's out there, I don't care. Anyone. Please, just save me.
Help me help me help me help me help me help me help me help me...
Day ??
I saw them.
They're real.
They're standing on the sea. Walking toward me.
Mother's wearing her old gray dress. Father's still so tall.
Their skin is ashen. They don't blink. Their feet don't touch the water.
Their eyes glow a strange green. Like ghosts.
It's been so many years. So many. I've missed them so much.
They're holding out their hands.
Mum and Dad have come to take me home.

673.title: Syndicate Rules
673.content:
Adamant Syndicate Employment Regulations - Novaris HQ

1. Working Hours
The working week runs from Monday through Saturday.
Working hours are 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., with a lunch break from noon to 2 p.m.
Overtime is voluntary.
2. Attendance
Three late arrivals cost you a day's pay. Five are treated as an unexcused absence.
Arriving 30 minutes or more late will be treated as an unexcused absence. Any employee with an unexcused absence that month will forfeit their monthly preservation allowance (Graveborn employees) or away-from-home hazard allowance (living employees). More than three unexcused absences will result in the loss of half a month's pay, as well as eligibility for performance awards and the year-end bonus.
Sick leave requires a medical certificate from an approved hospital in Novaris.
(Note: Local hospitals offer limb replacement only. They do not treat colds, stomach complaints, or other ailments affecting the living. Employees with serious illnesses should apply to the relevant supervisory department for a transfer.)
3. Performance Reviews
All departments are assessed on a six-grade scale: S, A, B, C, D, and E...
(The next seven pages and more cover the purpose of reviews, the organizational structure, procedures, and grade-based bonuses. Your eyes glaze over. You spare a thought for the poor souls working for the Adamant Syndicate and feel very glad that, as a mage, you answer to yourself.)
4. Reporting Requirements
Daily reports: Submit before the next working day. Include the day's accomplishments and plans for the following day. Miss three consecutive reports, and coffee for the entire department is on you.
Weekly reports: Submit to your department head before the weekly meeting at 3 p.m. on Friday.
Monthly reports: Submit to your department head by 5 p.m. on the 25th of each month.
5. Performance Targets
Minimum monthly profit targets vary by role and will be explained in person upon joining.
Profits above your target can be converted into Adamant Points. These may be redeemed for medicines not covered by the Syndicate, including skin-and-bone restorative salve, medicated patches, and fast-acting heart pills for the living.

684.title: The Bird and the Prince
684.content:
(Neat and elegant handwriting)
Once upon a time, at the heart of Savannah stood a statue of a prince.
The prince was gilded from head to toe, his eyes and sword hilt set with gems as blue and sparkling as the sea. Everyone in the city admired his noble, majestic figure.
Through his sapphire eyes, the statue witnessed the many sorrows and hardships of the mortal world. Sorrow filled his heart, and glistening tears streamed from his beautiful eyes.
One day, a swallow flew in from the south and caught one of the prince's tears in its beak. Like the people of the city, the swallow found itself utterly charmed by him.
"Please take the gems and gold from my body to those who need them. With a heart of lead and a body of stone, I have no use for such treasures," the prince pleaded with the swallow.
The swallow heeded the prince's wish. It carried the gems and gold to the slums, bringing warmth and hope to those living in poverty. Meanwhile, the prince slowly lost his luster.
With winter fast approaching, snow would soon blanket the entire city.
"I'm afraid I'll soon freeze to death," the swallow said in a frail voice, curling up at the prince's feet. "Still, I'd rather die than leave your side."
The prince looked at the shivering swallow, and for the first time, his heart of lead was seized by fear. Although he dreaded spending the long winter alone, it would break his heart to see the swallow die at his feet.
"No, you have to go," the prince told the swallow, his voice not as gentle as before. "I don't need your company anymore. Your presence only reminds me how ugly and useless I've become!"
"But..."
"Leave! Return to the warmth of the south!" the prince ordered sternly. "And don't ever come back!"
The swallow beat its wings in despair. It gave the statue, now only a shadow of its former glory, one last look. Then, with a mournful cry, it soared into the sky and never returned.
Finally, winter came.
Snow settled upon the prince's bare head. His gems were gone, his beautiful appearance had crumbled, and he had lost his only companion.
He still towered over the city, smiling down at it. Yet that smile was frozen forever.

He always shows up whenever I'm alone, offering compliments that never quite ring true.
What game is he playing? Should I trust him?
The fact that he's a ▇▇▇ is reason enough to put me on my guard. That woman is a ▇▇▇ too. Are they working together, hoping to expose my feet of clay?

690.content:
That ▇▇▇ curse! It's flaring up!
Black spikes are growing all over my back! Are they feathers? Or bone spurs? I have no idea!
It hurts so much...
Mother, why did you bring me into this world? Why do I have to bear this curse and suffer because of it?
I can't hide them anymore. My clothes are about to burst... I can't ▇▇ anymore...
If anyone sees my condition, I'm finished.

691.title: How have you been lately?
691.content:
嗨，<style="stress"><player_name></style>，好久不见！你和你的两只小仓鼠怎么样了？
没想到这次的委托人竟然是你，风浪与漂泊之神恐怕都要为这巧合惊叹吧。
言归正传，关于你打听的事，我的确有点头绪。
前段时间我出海，途径了一片名叫<style="highlight">流光海</style>的海域。
海域南部岛屿上有个沿海的蛮血村落<style="highlight">卡什澜</style>，那里的村民抱怨，<style="highlight">最近潮汐变得有些不规律。</style>
可别小瞧潮汐带来的影响。别说生态问题、海水交换什么的了（索尼娅和妈妈们说的，我搞不太懂），只说出海，一旦潮汐乱了，过往的经验也就算全白费了。
对于靠海吃海的渔民来说，这可是关乎生存的危机。
我知道你肯定会去一趟卡什澜，所以多余的话就不说了，只有一句：千万注意安全。大海永远比我们想得更大更深、更美更神秘……也更危险。
最后，愿风浪与漂泊之神祝福你，朋友。愿风帆带你去往你梦想之地。

692.title: 深海裔的童谣
692.content:
（破碎的贝壳上刻着如水面涟漪般的圆圈图案，这是海裔的文字）
（艾菲拉耐心地为你逐字逐句翻译。其中一首是快乐的童谣，而另一首似乎是给深海裔幼童的警告……）
<style="highlight">唱给幼童的歌谣</style>
旋涡转啊，一圈又一圈，
黏糊糊，软绵绵，趴在礁石间。
快快躲进裂缝里面——
等着妈妈，游回身边。

深海暗啊，宽广无边，
兄弟姐妹，转得正欢。
谁捉住了那只逃走的小蟹，
就能被妈妈挂在腕足尖，
晃晃悠悠，一夜梦甜。

<style="highlight">给幼童的警告</style>
向下一寸，影子便多凉一分，
向下一丈，名字便碎成微光。
邃暗之下仍有邃暗，
呼唤之后接着呼唤。

你以为那是路的地方，早已张开巨口；
你以为那是家的地方——醒醒吧，旅人，
你早已跨过那条界线，
它舔了舔牙，说：“欢迎回家，我的心肝”。

696.title: 旧梦糖果配方
696.content:
普通糖果对亡灵而言毫无意义。若要让糖果拥有唤醒感官的力量，需遵循以下三个步骤：
一、准备糖胚
普通糖果仅作为承载感官的“糖胚”使用。
二、调配梦引
“梦引”是唤醒感觉的核心，分为三种：
味引：需使用特定的食材与香料，模拟出对应的气味与味道。
声引：需借助特定的发声材料，模拟出一段声音。
色引：需利用带有魔力的鲜艳材料，模拟出色彩与短暂画面。
三、定型与融合
以<style="highlight">往生之手</style>为原料，熬制定型液。将调配好的梦引在定型液中稳固，随后与糖胚完全融合。至此，旧梦糖果方可制作完成。

698.title: 给生我的人
698.content:
咱也不知道这东西该往哪儿漂，就当你们能看见好了。
咱现在住在一个叫卡什澜的地方。这儿的人都又高又大的，整个村子除了小孩，就咱最矮！他们还动不动就拍肩膀捶胸口，疼得要命！但他们心眼不坏，有好吃的也会给咱留一份。
就是吧，最近咱惦记着怎么和他们把关系处好点，可咱一点也不擅长这事儿。
咱偶尔会想，你们到底长什么样呢？算了，问了也白问，你们又认不出来咱。
P.S.咱做的水行器跑得飞快，厉害吧？

706.content:
Aurelia Starfish is an unusual creature capable of mimicking sunlight. It was once kept at Mortimer Manor to help the blood thralls ease their discomfort from prolonged lack of sunlight.

310166.title: Notes
310166.content:
I never imagined I'd be locked up in this sunless tunnel, with each day filled with endless digging. In the beginning, I would speak to my fellow companions, but silence soon engulfed the entire tunnel.

The workers from the other clans began to grow restless and looked at me with a strange intensity. When I looked into their eyes, cold fear crept up my spine.

My dear child, not a moment passes that I do not wish I was by your side.

When I think of you, what little warmth remains in my heart rekindles. You must remember to look after yourself, and I will do my best to escape this place and return to you.

<align="right"> Ames

310170.title: Notes
310170.content:
I must be going mad. I can't focus or even recall what's become of my companions. There were five of us who were sent here to dig, but now we are only three. They couldn't have just vanished.

My companions have started to act erratic and unpredictable. They seem to be scared of me, and if I approach them of my own accord, they let out hoarse howls as if terrified.

Child, there are times when it seems as if I can see you standing before me. But when I reach out, my paws only land on the cold, weathered stone.

You are not a figment of my imagination, are you? I still remember your smiling face in the sunshine... your visage is the only clear image remaining in my mind.

311506.title: Day of Departure
311506.content:
Today marks the first leg of our journey to Alkali.

I've taken meticulous stock of our goods, which include those heavy pickaxes and dynamite fuses I painstakingly procured.

Recently, I've learned that Alkali has been flooded with treasure hunters. They've come from all over and are a mixed bag where professionalism is concerned.

While many seek treasure earnestly, it's likely some are out to capitalize on causing trouble.

Dura above, please protect us from bandits and all manner of natural disasters as we transport these goods to Alkali.

I ask for your blessing and protection.

311508.title: Memo
311508.content:
Step 1: Preliminary assessment

The excavation area was thoroughly surveyed to determine the depth of the target and the distribution of spider nests.
Develop an initial excavation route as well as a timetable.

Step 2: Resource consolidation

Manpower is a rapidly depleting resource. It's crucial to keep track of the head count, identify delays early, and alert the Quicksand Claws to bolster the ranks of laborers.

...

Tips for Supervisors

Tip #1: Manpower Allocation
Administer warnings: The least efficient workers can be used as spider fodder.

Tip #2: Develop Commitment
Inspire hope: Workers are to be informed that they'll be able to return home once the excavation work has concluded.

As for the truth, it's of no concern to them.

311512.title: Orders
311512.content:
Secret Letter

To the Supervisory Team,

As previously mentioned, we have identified the location of the tomb entrance. However, the ground is strewn with vile spider nests whose occupants are beyond hostile.

To ensure that our operations are not interfered with by those abominable creatures, follow these instructions:

1. Avoid the nests, delve deep into the earth, and excavate tunnels leading to the Dusk Lord's resting place.

2. During excavation, you have the authority to dispose of any worker who dares to disobey orders or slack off until the task has been completed. Make examples of them.

3. Report the progress of excavation to the Syndicate's senior leadership daily. If any abnormal circumstances arise, information must be conveyed immediately.

On that note, if you should notice strange-colored smoke while excavating, it's an expected anomaly. There is no cause for alarm.

311776.title: Secret Recipe
311776.content:
Bone Broth of the Grimmaw Clan 

Ingredients: 
One sandbeast leg 
Three scorpions 
Two lizards 
Four spider eggs 
Five blazing orchids  

Cooking Instructions: 
While the flaming orchids start to sizzle, clean the sandbeast leg and throw it in a pot to simmer. 
Add everything to the pot except the sizzling orchids. 
When the orchids finish sizzling, add the remaining juices to the pot and let it simmer a while before serving.

312240.title: Exclusive Commentary
312240.content:
(Page 1)
Preparation: Warm up for the preliminaries!
Let's decide on the opening line... "Welcome, everyone!"
I also think that's a bit lackluster and cliché, but my aunt says being "cliché" is a part of tradition...
It if it works this time, next let's try "Nice weather we've got today, how is everyone doing?" and see how it goes.
I've heard quite a few Lightbearer minstrels say this to get their crowds warmed up...

(Page 13)
Preparation: Tomorrow's ceremony!
Last time they said the weather was nice, we wound up with a huge sandstorm! ... Should I start with that?
No, the phrasing needs some refinement.
And you can't always offer platitudes when describing contestants, can you? This is a so-and-so contestant from such-and-such clan... That's a little boring...
I wonder how other places announce people...

(Page 29)
The competition venue tomorrow! The competitors! (There's also a red wolf head drawn beside it)
The contestant with that mane of fire hails from the XXX clan! Look at his mane! It blazes with even more intensity than his battle fervor!
Everyone says it's too risky to talk of that warrior like that. They say he has a terrible temper... but I want to give it a try!

(Page 62)
Grandpa was indeed right to remind me that as a presenter, unlike those minstrels, I shouldn't just describe and stir up emotions.
What I say should center around the competition!
Take this competitor, for example. Describing her feathers was a mistake (even though they are truly beautiful).
There should have been more emphasis on her sturdy thighs and kicking power, plus her nimble stance in the ring. Details that the crowd can't see clearly...

(Final Page)
I can't believe I finished filling all the pages in this book. It feels like there are more and more events for me to present and host.
There's been an increase in contestants, with some unwilling to disclose their information in advance.
This has also become a test for my eyesight and judgment!
I wonder if my presenting skills have improved since my first day.
Keep working hard, Mikola! (I just noticed that I do have the habit of speaking in the third-person.)

312769.title: To Mother
312769.content:
Mother, I've been thinking of you a lot lately. As one approaches the end of life, are they more fragile in ways? I know some larvae wrap themselves in a hard shell but never hatch. In a way, they haven't fully been born yet, enduring silently until the end.

You said that one must learn to admit weakness, and so I remembered every cry and every prayer from earlier days. Now I am praying, Mother, as you taught me to pray.

The people I was with are gone, hunted by spiders or lost to thirst, but I'm alive. I want to keep living.

Mother, how I want to stay in Alkali and be with you... There's so much more I want to do... (some of the text is smudged)

801645.title: Blight Beginning
801645.content:
A young blind mole rat was its first ever prey.

 The aroma of an unfamiliar mushroom lured the rat over. Elated, it thought it had found paradise—a place where it could feast on mushrooms to its heart's content. But soon, neurotoxins took hold, and it slipped into a deep slumber.

 It collapsed beneath the cap of the Blightshroom, which was watching it with one eye.

 At that time, the Blightshroom was merely the mother mushroom of the few blue mushrooms growing there. It was neither large nor conspicuous, but it was faintly aware of the subtle differences that set it apart from others. As it lowered its cap toward the rat, it smelled something warm and inviting—the scent of nourishment.

 Without hesitation, the Blightshroom extended its mycelium from its cap and burrowed it into the rat's body... The soil turned black, and the blue mushrooms around it quivered slightly, as if in laughter.

 The Blightshroom felt a surge of exhilaration. For the first time, it realized that living creatures could be consumed.

 Still unsatisfied after eating the rat, it released spores that fluttered through the air, growing, swelling, splitting, and spreading rapidly like contagion.

 Ever since then, more and more were drawn into this place, and they were never heard from again.

 The few who made it back were traumatized. With pale lips and constricted pupils, they mumbled incoherently under their breath. One said he glimpsed a red eye, a devilish bloom... Another said he simply wandered through a long, speckled, beautiful dream...

901021.title: Volcanic Beast
901021.content:
The Magmazard, born in the depths of a volcanic abyss in Ironhold Bay, was originally a catastrophic force from the underground. Having scales as tough as boulders, the Magmazard could breathe fire hot enough to melt gold and shatter rocks. After being tamed and granted intellect by Helthor, it has tirelessly fueled the god's furnace ever since.

 The Magmazard witnessed the dwarven empire at its peak and also saw its downfall. After Helthor's demise and the fading of his divine power, the Magmazard lost its intellect and memories. It forgot its name and fell into a deep slumber in the heart of the volcano.

 One day, the voices of Helthor's children reached its ears once again, stirring its long-lost memories.

 The earth quaked, and crimson light started pouring from the fissures. The Magmazard shook off the dust from its body and parted the lava, emerging once again in its homeland. It couldn't recognize the dwarves, nor understand the force driving its actions. Instinctively, it opened its gaping maw and unleashed a torrent of fire, just as it had done thousands of years ago.

 Only this time, instead of melting ores, the fire devoured the flesh and bones of the dwarves.

1004507.title: Falling Symbiosis
1004507.content:
At the swamp's edge, hidden deep within the forest, once lived a Wildborn warrior unlike any other.

To his tribe, hunting was sacred, and the warrior's blade should have been their pride. Yet his heart recoiled at the slaughter. The despair in the eyes of prey lingered with him longer than any victory. Though he bore the tribe's drills and scoldings, he never belonged.

"Perhaps living alongside prey suits me better," he once told his chieftain. The only reply was scolding and harsher drills.

In the end, he chose to leave.

Here in the swamp he found peace. A hut upon a rise, a yard fenced in, a fire always burning. Sweet fruit dangled from his rafters, waterfowls nested beneath the eaves, and fish swam undisturbed in the marsh. No killing, only harmony.

Until the moonless night when hunters came. Their footsteps, he knew too well. Gentle creatures collapsed in silence, their blood staining the waters. Flames licked the dark, torches mirrored across the rippling swamp like the world itself had caught fire.

He was no warrior now, only a deserter—unarmed, powerless. And when the revelry ended, he stepped into the swamp and lay among the dead, surrendering himself to their silence.

As darkness closed in, he understood what had once driven his kin to savagery. The longing to see the murderers fall. To drag them down, make them pay, make them share the fate of the innocent.

Now, the Gloommaw still stands on the swamp highland. Its fire never fades, its fruits never spoil. But those who trespass are swallowed whole, woven into its eternal "symbiosis".

1004508.title: Forgotten Duty
1004508.content:
Cinderwings was once a divine bird, guardian of the land. Her crimson plumage blazed like the dawn, her wings stirred whirlwinds. Yet fate gave her but one task: to guard a single sacred egg.

Day after day she circled above it. Years passed. She longed for change—companionship, a word of praise, anything. None came.

One morning, a whisper brushed her mind: "Do not guard the egg today. Look to the horizon instead."

Her wings obeyed before her will. She soared outward, bewildered, marveling at rivers, forests, mountains. She sang for joy. For the first time, she forgot her vigil.

When night fell, she returned to find black vines gnawing at the shell. Each time she strayed again, the tendrils crept higher, lashing at her back to wake her.

Half the egg was already consumed, writhing with corruption. She realized then that her ward and already fallen—abandoned the moment she looked away.

Remorse consumed her. She no longer remembered why she had flown off at all. Through the night she clawed and tore until her eyes burned red with exhaustion, clutching the tainted egg.

The divine bird no longer dreamed of mountains, rivers, or skies. She prayed only for change.

She wished for a voice that would say, "It's all right," and grant her forgiveness—or else condemn her, strike her down, and release her from regret.

1004509.title: Wailing Herd
1004509.content:
Once, the Doomscourge was nothing more than common livestock. Three docile creatures, fed each morning by their master's gentle hand. They knew nothing but warmth, and the simplest of bonds.

Then the God of Harvest fell.

A black mist swept across the land like a plague. Blessings turned into curses. Three harmless creatures fused into one—three heads upon a twisted body. The dull big slew with ease, the gentle ox trampled in fury, and the silent sheep shrieked with rage.

Their master had already withered into a crawling horror within the miasma, yet the fused beast remembered only that warm morning touch. Whenever any living being drew near, the three heads stirred with joy—their master had returned! They rushed forward, eager for that embrace.

Instead came carnage.

Their shattered minds could not control their monstrous frame. Their brute strength crushed every "master" into bloody ruin. When the mist lifted, they looked around in confusion, still searching for the one who would never return.

And so they wander, day after day—longing, wailing, waiting for a savior to release them from this endless nightmare.

1103233.title: Lady Starfallen
1103233.content:
"Lady Starfallen isn't a legend. She's real! I saw her! Right there on Starfall Lake."
"... She's gorgeous. You can't really see her face under that floppy hat, but she's all sparkly, like a big, walking crystal!"
"Yeah? Get too close and she'll drench you with a water orb, then dunk you under for good measure! How do I know? Let's just say I learned the hard way."
"Same here, soaked head to toe... more than once! Magic doesn't seem to work on her... Professor Loraine says you'll need a special crystal if you want to stand a chance against her."
"But she's not evil, right? The school wouldn't just let her hang around otherwise..."
The students of the Lyceum love to gossip about the magical being said to live on Starfall Lake. To hear them tell it, Lady Starfallen isn't evil at all. She's less a monster and more like a lonely, mischievous water sprite who spends her days splashing around by the shore.
"Come on, it's only water. Nothing to be afraid of, right? Go on. Feast your eyes on the skirt woven from flowing water and the soft cap gleaming like crystal. Just indulge that curiosity of yours."
Right there, on Starfall Lake...

1103234.title: Silentwood Whispers
1103234.content:
Have you ever heard the whispers rising from the depths of the forest?

It sounds almost like an old friend calling your name from far away, pleading for help. The next thing you know, you've stopped walking, listening without meaning to. The voice flickers in and out, gentle yet urgent, half-plea and half-lament. You can't turn away. Step by step, you find yourself moving toward it, wanting to hear it more clearly... and more clearly still...

Suddenly, an ancient giant tree looms before you, its branches blotting out the sky. Its roots twist deep into the earth, yet its trunk is rotten, steeped in the scent of death. The patterns on its bark form the face of a sorrowful elder, watching you in pain. One of its vines reaches out, lifting you effortlessly into its dead limbs, turning you into its nourishment.

And in that moment, you finally understand... the whisper wasn't a friend calling to you. It was the tree's way of luring its prey closer.

1103235.title: Scarecrow in the Fields
1103235.content:
In the golden wheat fields stands a lone scarecrow. Its head droops beneath a wide straw hat, and its woven arms sway gently in the wind, keeping the birds from daring to touch the grain.

To anyone passing by, it's nothing more than an ordinary scarecrow.

One day, a wandering mage happens to pass through. He pauses beside the scarecrow, struck by how lonely it looks. With a simple spell, he gives the still figure a breath of life.

The scarecrow lifts its head for the first time. The mage smiles and tells it to go find what life means for itself.

The scarecrow doesn't understand what life truly is, nor what meaning it is supposed to seek. So it watches the world from where it stands. Day after day, it sees farmers cutting the ripe wheat with their sickles. It listens as adults tell children stories about scarecrows, calling them cursed vessels that bind wandering souls or abominations that bring misfortune to travelers. The children always finish the story with the same loud declaration, "Scarecrows are terrifying!"

It realizes, "So this... is what a scarecrow is."
...
In the golden wheat fields stands a lone scarecrow. It raises its head and shows the nearby children a silent grin. The sickle in its hand catches the moonlight with a cold shimmer. From the shadows beneath the wheat comes the clean sound of something being cut. A flock of crows bursts into the air with startled cries and scatters into the night.

1500004.title: Starlit Whispers
1500004.content:
Have you ever believed the world was governed by laws and order? Have you ever believed those laws could never change?
If you have—if that belief has never once wavered—then go and find it.
Go to the land where young knights and nobles ride freely beneath the sun, laughing without a care. A thousand years ago, it was a scarred wasteland strewn with bones. Search there.
Follow the Forest Guardians' hurried footsteps into the woods. There, beneath the night sky, behold the violet starlight.
When the wind passes through shattered altars and sun-bleached bones, you'll hear it sigh—like a dying man begging for water, or someone robbed of their tongue struggling to form their first sound.
The deep-violet starlight begins to shine, its glow flowing like a thick, viscous liquid.
It begins to speak, and in its words, order is born.
"I swear I saw it!" a crazed hunter shouts in the tavern, flailing his arms. "It had a lion's body and an eagle's wings, but no face! Its face was... a spinning nebula! A blinding mass of starlight! And there was a huge disk covered in symbols set into its back, like it was carrying its own gravestone!"
Most people dismiss his story as the ramblings of a drunk. The Forest Guardians say nothing.
By morning, the hunter who had loudly shared his story in the tavern is found dead in his room.
His face is frozen in terror, his mouth open in a silent scream. His tongue is gone. So is the hand that tried to record what he saw.

The deep-violet starlight begins to shine, its glow flowing like a thick, viscous liquid.
It begins to speak, and in its words, order is born.
"I swear I saw it!" a crazed hunter shouts in the tavern, flailing his arms. "It had a lion's body and an eagle's wings, but no face! Its face was... a spinning nebula! A blinding mass of starlight! And there was a huge disk covered in symbols set into its back, like it was carrying its own gravestone!"
Most people dismiss his story as the ramblings of a drunk. The Forest Guardians say nothing.
By morning, the hunter who had loudly shared his story in the tavern is found dead in his room.
His face is frozen in terror, his mouth open in a silent scream. His tongue is gone. So is the hand that tried to record what he saw.

1701262.title: Ideal Subject
1701262.content:
An unknown scientist once dwelled atop a towering reef battered by ferocious waves.

He was a mortal, yet he had died once before.

He perished in an explosion after a failed experiment, much like countless other fanatical researchers before him. Unable to find his body, some kindhearted Graveborn had no choice but to prepare a funeral in his name.

As his eulogy was being delivered, a grotesque, horrifying figure crawled from the ruins of his laboratory. Hunched over and bearing six arms, the scientist had lived on—not as a Graveborn, but in some incomprehensible form.

No one knew how he had done it, and he couldn't be bothered to explain. He simply guffawed maniacally—one hand clutching a test tube, another holding a detector, two supporting him in place of legs, and the last two brandishing enormous syringes, eager to give every Graveborn present an injection.

"That was terrifying!" The Graveborn screamed and fled in all directions. Fear of the unknown took hold of their minds.

At last, silence returned to the ruins of the laboratory, allowing the scientist to resume his experiments. Beasts, corpses, and prisoners all became his test subjects, yet the results still fell short of his expectations.

When a ray of moonlight struck a shard of mirror, he caught sight of his six arms and the green fluid pulsing beneath his skin. He found his bizarre transformation utterly captivating.

After studying his reflection for a long while, a smile crept across his face.

As it turned out, the best test subject had always been himself.

1701263.title: Grave of Flowers
1701263.content:
Once upon a time, a mortal girl braved the seas to reach Novaris. Driven by her love of botany, she vowed to seek out every plant and blossom that grew across Esperia.

On the outskirts of the Graveborn city, where dawn never came, she stumbled upon a dreamlike sea of flowers...

She was overjoyed to see the vivid red flowers known among the local Graveborn as "candle blossoms". The breathtaking sight made her forget both the hardships of her journey and the guards' warnings.

The mesmerizing scent of the flowers dulled everything—her exhaustion, her pain, her memories... even the thought of ever leaving.

She strolled through the sea of flowers. As she brushed her hand over the petals, she felt a mild sting, like the jab of a needle. Intrigued, she quickly noted down the peculiar sensation.

She wandered through the sea of flowers. The blossoms swayed at her feet, as if trying to keep her there so she could admire them. She found herself slowing down without realizing it. "Could these flowers have minds of their own?" Fascinated, she recorded the thought.

She ambled through the sea of flowers. The flowers remained vividly red as the moon passed through its phases, and they were all she could see. Eventually, the pen and paper slipped from her hand and fell to the ground.

She roamed through the sea of flowers. Blood-red candle blossoms burst through her skin from within, tearing apart her face. Her steps faltered for a moment, until withered branches coiled around her legs and forced her onward...

To this day, "she" still meanders through the sea of flowers.

4163802.content:
<style="highlight">Burn this letter after you read it</style>

The lord has been left with no choice but to pull out this plan because the stubborn Northville villagers refused to grow Gemvine grapes. They will have to agree to our terms once Northville loses its only source of income. It's regrettable that things have come to this point. Failure is not an option!
 
Step 1: Lazell and his men will disguise themselves as Northville villagers, sneak into the village, and spread lamp oil everywhere. Then, they will find a hiding spot and wait for the mage's signal.
Step 2: The mage will summon a fire elemental to make the fire look like an accident. If the fire isn't intense enough, you need to add more firewood to make it blaze!
 
Note: Hogan will be hard to fool. Just in case, find a scapegoat for all of this. Be smart and try to adapt if the situation changes.

As dusk approaches, the villagers will be preparing dinner.

The Wheat Brew is produced from high-quality wheat through refined fermentation. It is featured with the clever combination of a tangy flavor, refreshing quality, and impressive after-taste. It is a special treat for buyers in scorching summer or the chilly winter.

Based on the market survey, we recommend promoting Northville Wheat Brew to expand its market presence while maintaining strict quality control to ensure buyers enjoy the finest beverage.

4165355.title: Farmer's Diary
4165355.content:
The villagers were all frightened, not just by the recent fire but by the impending cold and the arrival of bandits.

Although the Chief requested <s>armored</s> guards from Holistone, they didn't help much.

People from Northville rarely talk to those from Southville, and I've heard they're not doing well either.

But recently, General Hogan has brought in a mage and some other talented folks. They were able to change the place a lot, from what I hear.

It was like whoosh, zap, boom, and then all the trouble was gone. I don't really under any magic, but it sure is convenient.

Anyway, I need to keep working in my fields.

4166254.title: Patroller Order
4166254.content:
Follow the main road to the south when the first star rises.

Return from the south via a side route in the evening when the shadow of an arm is as long as a longsword. They sometimes take a short break at the traveler's camp.

Get across the river to the other side before the patrollers pass through! Make sure to loosen up the bowstrings and wrap all metal weapons in linen beforehand... Most importantly, do not make a sound!

Ignore the Lightbearers. Let me say this again: <style="highlight">the Wilders are our primary objective</style>! Only the Wilders have bounties on their heads. Don't waste your time!

4166806.title: Month ?? Day ?? - Heavy rain
4166806.content:
It's raining today, and my sister didn't go out, spending the whole day with us!
I wish it would rain every day.
My sister told me that if it keeps raining, there will be no food to eat, and we will go hungry.
If my sister could stay home with us, I would willingly go without food!
Annie agrees too!
(Below is a circle drawn in a squiggly manner)


Month ?? Day ?? - Drizzling

It's raining today, but my sister said she must go hunting.
In the evening, my sister came back with the prey she caught.
Both my sister and the prey are soaking wet.
Grandma made a big pot of meat soup!
My sister said that if we dry the fur tomorrow, we can exchange it for some oats and milk.
We'll be able to have oatmeal porridge with milk soon!


Month ?? Day ?? - Cloudly, overcast

The fur has been drying for a day, but it's still not fully dry and smells a bit.
My sister said that this fur is no longer good and asked us to throw it away.
Grandma can't bear to, so Annie and I want to try drying it a bit more.
May Dura bless us. I hope there's clear weather soon.

4166820.title: Outlanders Again...
4166820.content:
A group of outlanders is in town.

They claim to be traders from the <style="highlight">Adamant Syndicate</style>. They greeted each household and said they didn't plan to stay long.

Some villagers were distrustful, but the atmosphere improved after the outlanders kindly greeted every household. They set up camp outside the village, selling marbles and trinkets.

I can't say I like them, but I don't hate them either. Outlanders are like seeds carried by the wind from afar. If the forest accepts them, they'll be allowed to settle down on this fertile land.

The forest seems to be getting restless. Since the fall season, there have been three incidents of <style="highlight">wild beasts entering the village and hurting people.</style>

The chief has sent word to the Thorned Guards. I can only hope my legs get better before they get here. 

<align="right">Moon of Fading Stars, Dolio

4166821.title: Weird...
4166821.content:
That thing is still growing.

That <style="highlight">blackish purple plant</style> seems to have shot up from the ground overnight and grown into a thickness resembling a python within days. As I write this journal entry, it continues to squiggle and grow.

There's also something else. When I was limping back home in the evening, I saw a golden deer licking the sap coming out from the stem of that plant almost frenziedly, like livestock trying to get salt from the sweat on a farmer's arm, without any sign of self-awareness in its eyes.

The only good news is that <style="highlight">Eomir the Sage</style> personally came to investigate the situation. He studied the soil around the plant's roots with his hands and asked about the animal attacks. I pointed to my injured leg and told him everything that I knew.

It is a great honor to be in Master Eomir's personal care. Blessed Misarte, I pray to you, the stars, and the Lucent Tree. May the wisdom of the great sage restore peace and serenity to our village.

<align="right">Moon of Fading Stars, Doriogen

4166822.title: Farewell...
4166822.content:
Why have you forsaken us, Misarte?!

All the trees have <style="highlight">withered and died overnight</style>. I lived through forty leaf falling seasons and have never seen such a sight. That strange plant continues to thrive as if its roots have sucked dry the life force of this land.

The putrid black liquid has seeped into the soil, releasing a hazy miasma under the sun... That darn miasma! It burns my nose and throat!

The children weep, their voices as croaky as crows. The elderly, like pieces of weathered wood without voices... We had to leave our home before that plant could take everything from us.

Why has Master Eomir stopped coming? Where are the Thorned Guards? The Dusk Patrollers are stationed at Lunadorf afar... But if we can contact them, maybe...

I take my leave of you, my beloved home. Oh, blessed Misarte, if you can hear me, please...

4168340.content:
The Taran River flows day and night,
Nourishing plants with a touch so light,
Sheltering creatures in her gentle embrace.

Our years are washed by Taran's flow,
Its waters pure, our spirits glow.
With every sip, we cleanse our woes,

Our bond with the river, deep and wide,
If one day I must part, let it be grand,

4168468.title: Month ?? Day ?? - Drizzling
4168468.content:
Today, I encountered a red-haired woman in the rain.
Despite her ordinary appearance, she's truly an innocent girl with a touch of wildness of the mountain folks. It made our conversation all the more delightful and refreshing.
She seemed reluctant to let me go, saying something like, "Proceed at your own risk"... However, the footsteps of the famed Reye the Poet shall never stop for a wildflower by the road.


Month ?? Day ?? - The sunshine today resembles brilliant golden coins

Oh, what a great day! I took a short nap under the warm sun, and by the time I woke, the stars in the night were as beautiful as diamonds.
However, my so-called companions seem to have forgotten all about me.
Those caravans, saying that they'll ditch me if I dawdle and that they are under no obligation to give me a free ride, to begin with... Oh, how vulgar and greedy they are, completely oblivious of the significance of art and contemplation to a poet such as me!
They will get what they deserve!
    

Month ?? Day ?? - The raging wind is colder than my tears

Those bloody bandits! Thieves! Scoundrels!
I've already sung them my most exquisite ballads and showed them that I have nothing of value on me (for the moment!)...
Yet they stripped me of my hood and coat?!
How rude! How disgraceful of them!
Oh, the mountain wind is so cold that it's turning my tears into ice.
How come a great poet like myself has to suffer such tribulations?


Month ?? Day ?? - Nocturnal roars. Wild beasts or golems?

No way. I have to get away from this detestable, wretched, barren place!
Why are there strange mechanical devices in addition to wild beasts? What is this place? My strength betrays me. I can go no further!

Research Target: Wild Orchid Plant Group

4174996.title: Month ?? Day 17
4174996.content:
Day 6 of the excavation of Ruin 293, the weather is sunny. Excavations continued today in Zone 3.
Zone Clearing: 5

Visible Remains: Three fragments (numbered 34, 35, 36), assembled to form the upper part of the left decorative wall of the Holy Temple, missing about 1/3, awaiting further excavation.

Carving Details: A towering tree bridging heaven and earth, showcasing radiance and creatures in reverence.

Excavation Log: Can be regarded as an expression of worship for the "Tree of Life" or "Tree Spirit". Daley believes this is inevitably related to the Wilders, but this is one of the biases stemming from her limited knowledge as a newcomer; namely, faith associated with trees is exclusively attributed to Wilders.

In my opinion, scholar Daley's education in ancient history evidently didn't equip her with sufficient knowledge to grasp the widespread nature of ancient tree spirit worship.

4174997.title: Month ?? Day 2?
4174997.content:
Day 11 of the exploration of Ruin 293, the weather is clear. Today, the excavation of Zone 3 was completed.

Zone Clearing: 2

Visible Remains: Two fragments (numbered 52, 53), assembled to restore the missing section of the lower part of the left decorative wall of the Holy Temple. Scholar Daley has already begun organizing manpower for repairs.

Carving Details: The ground beneath the immense tree, with distinct roots.

Excavation Log: The era is confirmed to be from the —— period to the —— period. Prior to this, worship of concepts like the "Tree of Life", "Tree Spirit", and "Giant Tree" often depicted only the upper parts of trees, emphasizing their radiance and splendid postures. However, after — years, works gradually began to depict the content of the tree roots below, and presentation leaned more toward negativity and rejection.

Scholar Daley believes this is a common process of worship evolution: as concepts develop, there emerge opposing entities that need to be confronted. But I still have reservations about this: in many worship patterns, the opposing entities are often external forces like natural disasters, invaders, and the like, whereas a similar tree root image is a continuous presence integrated with the original object of worship.

Perhaps there are more underlying meanings to be uncovered.
