Scholar Daley believes this is a common process of worship evolution: as concepts develop, there emerge opposing entities that need to be confronted. But I still have reservations about this: in many worship patterns, the opposing entities are often external forces like natural disasters, invaders, and the like, whereas a similar tree root image is a continuous presence integrated with the original object of worship.

Perhaps there are more underlying meanings to be uncovered.

4174999.content:
There's no denying that since my first step into this ruin, all I've seen has left a deep impression. The structures, including these remnants nearby, exude an aura of antiquity and solemnity. They stand there silently, as if narrating a distant era. Once a non-believer in Nakalig, I felt an inexplicable sense of reverence surge within me, blossoming in the depths of my heart before spreading to every corner of my being.

From that moment on, I knew I had found my purpose. As the most promising scholar of the Evergreen Conservatory, I am determined to uncover the secrets hidden beneath this ruin, no matter how challenging that may be!

It was better than nothing. He thought.

Like the case at hand, his small agency, and his supposed identity as a great detective—with the absence of his pipe, everything else appeared to be of little consequence.

4176831.title: Exclusion Edict
4176831.content:
Effective immediately! Block off the forests and mountains! Prohibit all outlanders from entering!

Swarms of outlanders often come to the edge of the forest, attempting to deceive us with false earnestness and sorrowful stories.

I am well aware of the kind, gentle nature of the Wilders but remember! Now is not the time to extend a helping hand.

Foreign bandits can and will attempt to masquerade as refugees in an attempt to infiltrate the forest.
We cannot ignore the possibility that all of this is part of a despicable plot from these outlanders, motivated by their desire to plunder the abundance of the Dark Forest.

They intend to seize our forest, our homeland, and everything we know using methods that do not involve blades or bloodshed!

Remember, extending a helping hand to outlanders signifies the success of their mission.

Only thorns can pierce through lies and illusions. We must take up arms and defend our people who have lived here for generations.

<align="right">To the Thorns who pierce through the filth
<align="right">Master Eomir

4176857.title: Month ?? Day ??
4176857.content:
Watching the team celebrate Inrick's birthday, I was reminded of that incident.

Months back, Master Eomir unexpectedly issued a sudden order for the transportation of goods.

The number of weapons is equal to half of a squad. Normally, we don't need so much equipment during missions. Also, they're being transported to the outskirts of the forest camp...

This is indeed strange, but the squad leader is correct. The sage has unmatched foresight and wisdom. We don't need to question it.

But why? That transportation directive only had a two-week execution time?!

To fulfill the command, I missed my daughter Shirli's birthday for the first time!

While Thorned Guards are always in my heart, the weight of duty is difficult to bear.

We will send regular reports on the excavations. Remember that the number of laborers will be the biggest factor in our success, so please <style="highlight">provide us with more</style>.

Your compatriots sent to "monitor progress" arrived at our tent the day before yesterday, so rest assured that as your deputies, they will be treated as guests of honor.

<style="highlight">The Adamant Syndicate</style> will not forget your contributions. Sit tight in camp and await the monumental news we'll bring.

503100046.title: Final Entry
503100046.content:
Today, we watched 20 more of our kin being sent into the tunnels. What exactly are the Adamant Syndicate and Quicksand Claws excavating? There is no treasure here, only spiders and horrible creatures as black as mist.

I don't believe the overseer when he says I can return home once the digging is done, but I'm remaining hopeful.
...
Today, five dirt-covered, lifeless corpses lie strewn before my eyes.

Their white faces gave me a deeper understanding of "passing away". Will I close my eyes forever like them before I am free?
...
I pray to the gods that rescuers will arrive before I am sent through the tunnel. I am willing to trade ten years of my life just to be saved before then.
...
This is my last record, as I'm to be sent to the tunnels as well. I don't know what awaits me. It seems prayers are useless and everything is hopelessly coming to an end.
...

503400208.title: Heartless
503400208.content:
(Scribbled and rough handwriting, but carved with knife marks so extraordinarily deep that long years and collapsing rubble have failed to wear them away)

<style="highlight">The sun is falling.</style>
This is the cruelest twilight.
Divine blood drenches the earth and sky.
The sky is crimson. The desert is crimson.
The depths of the earth are still red.
<style="highlight">None can be rid of it.</style>

Sacred bones cannot hide abominable sins.
This crimson never fades.
It will cover the souls and memories of all who dwell here.
<style="highlight">This crimson belongs to the departed gods.</style>

(The writing underneath is covered by a large splash of deep black and red traces. Even with the age, these traces exude an ominous fishy odor and blur the inscription)

503600042.title: Heed My Words
503600042.content:
... This inscription is for you, Merlin.

When you came here for our shared vision and saw this tablet, the Hypogean's seal should have been loosened.

With the power remaining from the Dusk Lord, I sealed the Hypogean of illusion here.

But forces hidden in the darkness will not sit idly by, and the seals will one day be weakened.

That is when you and your companions will take a stand.
If the seal continues to wane, you must defeat the Hypogean once more to fortify it!

... There is no need to fear the might of the Hypogean, for you have gained the approval of the gods. With their favor, you will surely triumph!

... Dearest Merlin, may the light be with you.

... Blessings in the name of Dura!

504300047.title: Supply Request
504300047.content:
We have applied to our superiors for funding to improve transport conditions and equipment. We're dealing with live animals here. If they die, it stands to reason that we can't sell them.

The last batch of falcons was too wild, with three buyers complaining after the sales. Expect costs to go up. The gleamtails are selling, but the unit price is too low, and the shipment needs to be resupplied.

Amidst the <style="highlight">Remnant Peaks</style>, near the temple, lies a lake where a bird with a yellow crest dwells. These elements make for an excellent narrative. Buyers are scarce. They'll employ their imaginations to justify the overvalued goods.

The target price is three times what it was last time. The higher, the better, and the people can afford it.

504500027.title: Dear Illucia
504500027.content:
Why hasn't the life force of the jungle converged on me? The corruption has surely taken over the roots of the Lucent Tree. Isn't this enough? Must we sacrifice all that the jungle has left? 

Those brats wounded me at the ceremony. Nasty hatchlings! They have so much time ahead of them, with countless choices and possibilities waiting!

How ruthless and unforgiving time can be! Fine! If this grants me a rebirth to witness more miracles and explore more wonders of this world, then take it all; take everything here!

From the Dark Forest to the Vaduso Mountains, every drop of water, every inch of land, and every life that dwells and roams here are yours to manipulate, exploit, and wreck.

I have given up so much and lost so much. It is not yet time to surrender.

I'm asking only what I deserve, Illucia!

504500087.title: Corruption Log
504500087.content:
Upon exposure to sunlight, the black-purple soil emits a toxic mist that pervades the entire village.
Just standing outside the village and catching a whiff from a distance, I knew this place was done for!

Indeed, before long, many in the village fell ill one after another, which prompted most to flee this place.

Once they're gone, we must hurry to continue expanding the corruption.

Eomir has blocked all information from leaking. The Wind and Dusk factions are still in the dark for the time being.

But I know this is only temporary. We must act quickly.

My wish is for that giant tree to be corrupted as soon as possible. Surely then I'll receive Illucia's praise...

504600103.title: Warning
504600103.content:
Days ago, our kin foresaw a horrific disaster.

The chieftain attempted to warn others of the impending chaos, but most refused to heed our warnings. Even as Misarte fell, many still believed her remaining power would provide sanctuary for the Vaduso Mountains... such optimism was too hopeful...

Sooner or later, Misarte's power will diminish entirely, and the dimming glow of the Lucent Tree serves as proof.

Though some listened to our words, they were still unwilling to depart from this land. All I can say is that they fail to understand what a dreadful calamity awaits.

Are we the only ones who can escape this cruel fate? Is there any way to save them all?

504600104.content:
(Portions of text are smudged and indecipherable)

Poor Laura... no one believes she can take over as the elder.

Although I don't want to admit it, I know that after losing her child, she's often seemed distracted and worn out.

In a few days, we'll be leaving Vaduso. Before we set off, I must select a new candidate. But who could be more suitable than Laura?

Alas... If we had left someone in there that day, those despicable men in black wouldn't have succeeded. I regret this deeply.

Laura lost (smudged), and I lost (smudged) as well.

Misarte... why would you subject the Azure Seers to such a fate?

In a few days, we'll be leaving Vaduso. Before we set off, I must select a new candidate. But who could be more suitable than Laura?

Alas... If we had left someone in there that day, those despicable men in black wouldn't have succeeded. I regret this deeply.

Laura lost (smudged), and I lost (smudged) as well.

Misarte... why would you subject the Azure Seers to such a fate?

508300304.title: Tears of Crystal
508300304.content:
Deep within a celestrite mine lay a special frog's egg, out of place yet thriving. It grew and matured over time, drawing energy from the ore, which kept it from feeling alone in the quiet stillness. When the day of hatching finally came, the frog leapt into the world, eager to embrace the mother that had nurtured it. But all that awaited it were cold, broken shards.

 The frog's birth was a curse. It drained the energy from within the massive ore, causing it to crumble and shatter into fragments. The outside world was dark, cold, and harsh, but there was no returning to the comforting embrace it had once known. So, why not just destroy everything? Driven by this thought, it went into a frenzy and started absorbing energy from the veins hidden deep underground, leaving the ores dulled and shattered. With its icy claws swinging wildly, it followed its instincts, attacking anything that came too close.

 The mine then became a dreaded place after all those who ventured in disappeared. Legends of the Crystal Crawler strike fear into hearts: its clouded, lamp-like eyes, its ghostly form, and the icy webbed palms capable of tearing through flesh with ease.

 Things finally took a turn when a mage, sent by the Lightbearer Empire, arrived in Ironhold Bay and set foot in this bleak, desolate space by chance...

513100248.title: Mirror Spirit
513100248.content:
Once upon a time, in the days when Savannah was merely a modest city-state, there existed an exquisite full-length mirror that belonged to a woman of unparalleled beauty.

Despite the passage of time and the fading of the woman's beauty, the mirror stood quietly in the depths of the palace, devoid of life and thought.

It faithfully reflected the desires of all who stood before it—the noblewomen's obsession with youth, the avarice gleaming in the eyes of statesmen, even the frailty of knights stripped of their armor.

Day after day, it absorbed these ugly yet captivating emotions like a bottomless vessel.

Then came war. The Hypogeans descended, reducing all that humanity once possessed to ruin.

Consumed by overwhelming fear and despair, those who approached the mirror exposed humanity's most intense and pure desire—the desperate will to live.

With a piercing crack, the mirror finally buckled beneath the weight of the desires.

Could the mirror itself have harbored desires of its own?

And so it came to life, transforming into the Mirror Wraith, a fearsome Hypofiend draped in a lavish purple velvet cloak and bearing three enormous mirrors upon its back.

Instead of merely reflecting what stood before it, it began to devour it.

When you stand before the mirror, you do not see your own reflection, but a dreadful, deep-blue apparition. It reaches toward you with slender, deathly pale arms, dragging both your dearest treasure and your soul into the endless void with an eerie smile.

Are you simply gazing at the mirror, or has the thing within it already taken your place?

Well, maybe there is no difference between you and it anymore.

514100003.title: Deadwater Ripples
514100003.content:
"Have you noticed? There have been far fewer stray dogs and rats on the streets lately!"

"Some of those sent to clear the sludge never made it back..."

"Shh... I heard something coming from the secondary drainage..."

The people on the streets cut their conversations short and hurried away, driven by fear and unease. A sticky, blood-tinged odor lingered in the air.

The stench rose from the depths of the pipes.

From the filth and malice of the entire royal capital, the stagnant water in the pipes birthed a massive being in the darkness.

It had no eyes, yet it could hunt with perfect precision in absolute darkness. Though enormous, it glided soundlessly through the sticky mud.

When those greedy scavengers or careless vagrants wandered into its territory, it made no sound at all. It simply lay motionless in the waist-deep sludge, waiting for its prey to draw near on their own.

A bloody gust struck first. Then a gigantic, thorny tongue shot out from the darkness, coiling tightly around the prey. Before being dragged into its venom-dripping maw, the victim saw only an eyeless, frog face twisted in silent mockery of humanity's arrogance.

Listen, the strange gurgling from the secondary drainage is back.

Who's on its menu today?

516700008.title: Puppet Companion
516700008.content:
Sadly, the world has never been kind to misfits. His frightening appearance, strange voice, and awkward mannerisms made him the target of constant scorn, gradually turning him into a loner.

Since no one was willing to befriend him, he decided to create friends of his own.

And so, "Carolyn" came into being—a puppet with black button eyes, a subtle smile, and a tattered black dress. It took him a whole month to greet her without stammering, something he could never manage with real people.

After "Carolyn" came "Bobin", then "Spick", and many more. His room gradually filled with friends, the kind who would never leave. They offered him only their quiet companionship, listening to his halting speech, applauding at just the right moment, or wiping away his tears.

But over time, silent friends stopped meeting his needs. He longed to bond with people who had souls.

And so he began gathering wandering souls, sealing them inside his puppets one by one. They writhed and shrieked in agony, but he told himself that deep down, they were lonely too.

Lonely souls and a lonely man... They could stay together forever, never to be parted again.
